plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-classify

**数据分类分级** —— 查数据有没有分级标注与资产清单。

## 不装它会怎样

你的数据字典长这样：

```json
"fields": {
  "idcard": { "type": "string", "public": true },
  "phone":  { "type": "string", "public": true },
  "salary": { "type": "string", "public": true }
}
```

**身份证、手机号、薪资全标成 public。**

> **《数据安全法》第二十一条**
> 国家建立数据分类分级保护制度，根据数据**一旦遭到篡改、破坏、泄露
> 或者非法获取、非法利用**对国家安全、公共利益或者个人、组织合法权益
> 造成的**危害程度**，对数据实行分类分级保护。

**没有分级，就无法对不同的数据施加不同的保护强度** —— 加密、访问控制、
留存期限、出境评估，全都建立在「这是几级数据」之上。

## 关键词
**关键词**：数据分类分级 · 数据分级 · 数据密级 · 数据资产清单 · 数据台账 · 数据字典 · 数据安全法
**Keywords**: data classification · data grading · data inventory · data map · data security law

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 出现敏感数据但**找不到分级标注** |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到分级制度文档 · 找不到数据资产清单 |
| 🟡 中 | 所有数据都标成**公开级** |

## 「全是公开」为什么值得报

它通常不是「我们真的只有公开数据」，而是**分级工作没做完**（先标了个默认值）。

**分类分级的价值在于差异** —— 只有一级等于没有分级。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-classify
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-classify
```

![dsh-data-classify 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-classify/report.png)

![dsh-data-classify 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-classify/demo.png)

![dsh-data-classify 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-classify/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-data-classify --demo
dsh-data-classify --list-rules
dsh-data-classify --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **不判断「该定几级」** —— 分级标准由行业和组织决定，本工具不替你定。
- **分级可能存在于仓库外**（数据治理平台、内部文档）—— 报出来是提示你确认。
- **敏感数据靠字段名识别** —— 自定义命名会漏。
- **`CLASSIFY-ALL-PUBLIC` 是启发式** —— 只有「公开」一级同时出现在多处时才值得怀疑。
- 与 [dsh-pipia](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) 分工：
  那个查**评估流程**，这个查**数据本身有没有分级**。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [**数据分类分级**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: auto-compact long sessions after user idle time, before the KV cache expires.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-idle-compact

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that compacts a long session automatically once you stop replying. It runs before the model provider's KV cache expires, to save tokens.

## Why

Providers cache the prompt prefix of a conversation for a few minutes. While the cache is warm, re-reading a long history is cheap. Once it expires, your next message re-bills the whole history at the full, uncached input price.

If you walk away from a long session, this plugin compacts it while the cache is still warm. The summarization request is cheap, and when you come back your next turn starts from a much shorter prompt.

## How it works

1. When a session finishes a turn and waits for you, a timer starts.
2. Any new activity in that session cancels the timer, whether it's you replying or the agent starting work.
3. When the timer fires, the plugin measures the session's context with DSH's token meter.
4. If the context is longer than the threshold, the plugin compacts the session the same way `/compact` does: older history is replaced by a summary.

Subagent sessions are skipped, because they never wait for a user reply. If the agent is busy when the timer fires, the compaction is skipped and logged.

## Settings

Open **Plugins → Idle Compact** in the DSH Web UI:

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Context length threshold (tokens) | `256000` | Compact only when the session context is longer than this. |
| Idle time (seconds) | `300` (5 min) | How long you must go without replying before compacting. |

Both fields take whole numbers of at least 1. Changes apply without a restart. A changed idle time takes effect the next time a session starts waiting.

You can also set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: idle-compact
  config:
    contextThresholdTokens: 200000
    idleSeconds: 240
```

## Install

Requires DSH 0.2.0 or later with the Web UI. Its Plugins page hosts the settings form.

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact
```

Or, in the Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact` or a local checkout path.

## Token cost

Each compaction makes one summarization call to your model. It's cheap because the cache is warm, but it is spent even if you never return to that session. If most of your idle sessions are ones you abandon, raise the threshold.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: idle timers, the context check, and the compaction call. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the settings form on the Plugins page. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `idle-compact` row. |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Display metadata for the plugin manager. |

## License

MIT

# dsh-model-picker · 模型速选器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口右下角 **模型下拉框的左侧** 添加一个小按钮。
点击按钮弹出全量模型选择窗口：按提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、
真实能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮，加载 / 失败 / 会话占用等状态都有清晰呈现。
**选择模型后立即回写模型下拉框并生效** —— 因为它与原生下拉框共用同一条
per-session 模型目录与 `selectModel` 提交路径（"任一端切换，另一端立刻显示"）。

## 效果

![模型速选窗口（深色主题，中文界面）](screenshot_zh.png)

![模型下拉左侧的触发按钮](button.png)

- **触发按钮**：28px 圆形图标按钮，紧贴模型下拉左侧，与 composer 工具栏
  「+」按钮同风格（悬停 / 焦点环 / 禁用态齐全）。
- **选择窗口**（居中弹窗，主题变量配色，深浅色主题自适应）：
  - **头部**：标题 + 提供商/模型计数 + 关闭；
  - **最近使用**：打开即见上次用过的模型（最多 8 个，自动记录、本地持久化），
    每行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    点一下即切回常用模型；
  - **提供商筛选**：搜索框左侧的自定义下拉（全部提供商 / 单个提供商），
    跟随主题渲染（不用原生 `<select>`，避免深色主题下系统面板惨白）；
  - **搜索**：模型名 / 模型 id / 提供商名模糊匹配，↑↓ 移动高亮、Enter 选中、Esc 关闭；
  - **列表**：按提供商分组（DeepSeek 账号 / 官方优先），分组带色条与计数徽章，
    每行显示 **完整模型名** + **能力标签** + 「推理」徽章 + 「当前」徽章 + 选中勾，
    大列表按需懒渲染（滚动才加载，打开更快）；
  - **底部**：当前模型摘要 + **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器** + 关闭按钮；
  - **状态**：加载中（spinner）、加载失败（重试）、提供商加载失败（逐条提示）、
    当前模型已不可路由（警告）、会话被占用（专用文案）。

### 能力标签是真实数据

行内的 `📝 文本` / `🖼️ 图像` 标签**不是**从模型描述文字里猜的，而是读
**用户自己配置里声明的 `input` 列表**（pi-ai 提供商配置，如
`providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`）。实现走 DSH 已有的
`settings` Remote 读取 settings 文档，扫描各命名空间的 `providers → models[].input`
建索引；配置里没写 `input` 的提供商就不显示标签（如实反映配置，不做臆测）。
增删配置里的 `input`，标签随之变化。

> **契约说明（已验证）**：能力标签用 `group.id` 查询索引，而 `group.id` 与
> settings 中 `providers` 的**配置 key 同命名空间**（DSH 的 modelCatalog 以
> `provider.id` 作为分组 id、`provider.name` 作为显示名）。因此
> `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` 这类配置 key 能被可靠匹配；若未来 DSH
> 改变这一命名约定，标签会安静地不显示（不会报错），插件其余功能不受影响。

> **为什么只能从配置读（已验证）**：浏览器侧拿到的 `modelCatalog` RPC 返回的
> 模型对象**只有 `id` / `name` / `description` / `reasoning`，不含 `input`** ——
> DSH 的 Host 侧在构建浏览器目录时把 `input` 字段投影丢弃了（见
> `buildModelCatalog`）。因此插件无法从模型目录兜底读取能力，配置是浏览器侧
> 唯一的 `input` 来源。想给某个模型显示能力标签，就在 pi-ai 提供商配置里为它
> 写 `input`：
>
> ```yaml
> # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，llm-pi-ai 提供商配置内
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # 声明后插件即显示「文本 / 图像」标签
> ```
>
> 这也解释了为什么**同一个模型 id 在不同用户那里标签可能不同**——它如实反映
> 各自配置，而非模型本身的客观能力。

## 工作原理

1. 注册进 composer 的 **`conversation.input.right`** slot —— 这是一个
   `kind: list`、`scope: session` 的官方扩展点，composer 栏在渲染模型
   seat（`conversation.input.model`）之前渲染它，因此按钮天然出现在
   模型下拉的**左边**。
2. 通过 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` 拿到
   `ctx.modelDirectories`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`
   注册的共享服务），对当前会话解析出与原生下拉**同一个**
   `ModelDirectory` 实例。
3. 弹窗里选择模型 → `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`
   → 走与原生下拉完全相同的 `selectModel` RPC。成功后共享 store 更新，
   原生模型下拉的标签**自动回写**，会话模型切换立即生效。
4. 能力标签由 `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])` 注入的
   `settings` Remote 读取：`settings.describe()` 返回各命名空间的合并配置，
   从中提取 `provider → model → input[]`。注意 **`remote.<namespace>` 必须显式
   写进 inject 列表**（cordis 规则），只注入根 `remote` 会在访问时报
   `cannot get property "remote.settings" without inject`。
5. 子代理（subagent addressed）会话没有模型目录，按钮自动隐藏。

## 安装

支持 **web 与 desktop** 两个 profile（`platform: web` 的插件在两者中均生效）。

### 方式 A：git clone 后本地安装（推荐）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/faxble/dsh-model-picker.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

把 `/path/to/dsh-model-picker` 换成实际 clone 路径；桌面版把 `web` 换成
`desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

安装后重启 DeepSeek Harness，在「设置 → 插件」中启用 `dsh-model-picker`，
或确认它已自动启用。

### 方式 B：远程直接安装（免 clone）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:faxble/dsh-model-picker
```

### 方式 C：手动加入 profile（开发者调试用）

1. 在 profile（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）的 `package.json` 中：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker": "file:D:\\Dev\\VibeCoding\\dsh-model-picker"`；
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker"`。
2. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-model-picker/
├── package.json        # 包元数据 + dsh.client 声明（platform: web）
├── index.js            # Host 半身（no-op，仅承载 bundle 行）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch：一行 insert（name 为裸包名）
├── client.js           # 浏览器半身：ModuleLoader bundle（由 src/ 构建）
├── install.ps1         # 安装脚本（web / desktop）
├── src/                # 源码（ES modules，开发用）
│   ├── dict.js         #   zh/en 文案字典
│   ├── pure.js         #   纯逻辑：排序/搜索打分/MRU/能力标签（单测覆盖）
│   ├── style.js        #   CSS（主题变量）
│   ├── icons.js        #   SVG 图标
│   └── entry.js        #   ModuleLoader bundle 入口（组件 + apply）
├── scripts/build.mjs   # esbuild 打包脚本
├── test/               # node:test 单元测试
└── README.md
```

## 说明

- 纯前端插件：**运行时无构建、无运行时依赖**（只用 shell 已提供的 `react`），
  全部颜色来自 DSH 主题 CSS 变量，切换深浅色主题无需重载。
  `client.js` 是构建产物，开发期用 `pnpm build` 从 `src/` 生成。
- 不修改任何 DSH 核心代码；`conversation.input.right` 目前没有任何占用者，
  注册不会遮蔽既有 UI。
- 界面文案**中英双语**，随 DSH 系统语言自动切换（zh / en），外国用户可直接使用。
- 附加功能：**最近使用（MRU）置顶**、**搜索打分排序**（精确 > 前缀 > 包含）、
  **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器**、大列表**懒渲染**、焦点陷阱等无障碍支持。
  - 最近使用行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    提供商名在模型左侧、本地化并浅灰次要显示，跨提供商时避免同名模型混淆。
- 主题取值注意：**不要用 `--dsw-alias-brand-text` 做选中行文字色** ——
  它的语义是"品牌色块**上**的文字"（浅色主题设计值），深色主题下解析为深色，
  配软高亮底会变成黑字看不清；文字统一用 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`。

## 开发调试

- 改 `src/` 后执行 `pnpm build` 重新生成 `client.js`，再复制到 profile 触发
  HMR 热更新（页面无需刷新，DSH 会检测到文件变更并重新加载 bundle）：

  ```powershell
  pnpm build
  Copy-Item .\client.js $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-picker\client.js -Force
  ```

- 单元测试：`pnpm test`（`node --test`，覆盖 `src/pure.js` 的纯逻辑）。
- 构建校验：`pnpm check`（`node --check` 产物）。**CI 会校验 `client.js` 是否为
  最新构建**，改了 `src/` 忘了 build 会让 CI 失败。
- 若要源码改动即时生效（免复制），改用 `link:` 符号链接方式安装。
- 移除插件：DSH「设置 → 插件」里卸载 `dsh-model-picker` 即可。

plugins.description: ChatGPT subscription / GPT provider for DeepSeek Harness desktop: image input, host tools and DeepSeek/GPT switching. Harness 桌面版 ChatGPT 订阅适配器，支持图片、工具调用和模型切换。Community MIT plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

**把 ChatGPT 订阅带进 DeepSeek Harness。登录账户，选择 GPT，即可开始工作。** 无需 API Key，支持 GPT / DeepSeek 切换、图片理解，以及 Harness 的文件、搜索和终端工具。 **仅适用于 DeepSeek Harness。** 本插件不能安装到 DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 或普通聊天桌面客户端中。支持 Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS；当前实测基线为 0.2.0-rc.2。 [快速开始](#快速开始) · [使用文档](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [下载安装包](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/latest) · [English](README.en.md) ## 为什么使用 - **用自己的订阅**：通过 OpenAI 页面登录授权，无需配置 API Key。 - **两种模型，随时选择**：在会话中切换 GPT 与 DeepSeek，也可让新会话默认使用 GPT。 - **图片与工具一起用**：向支持图片的模型提问，使用 Harness 内置工具读取文件、编辑代码、搜索和运行命令。 - **思考强度可调**：在模型菜单中选择推理等级，档位与默认值自动匹配当前模型。 - **连接后即可选模型**：自动加载当前账户的可用模型，支持添加和切换多个账户。 - **免费开源**：MIT 许可；插件不额外收费。模型权限与使用额度取决于你的 ChatGPT 账户。 ## 快速开始 适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS**，需要可使用订阅模型的 ChatGPT 账户。 ### 1. 安装插件 在 **Plugins → Add plugin** 中填入： ```text dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.7 ``` Registry 选择 **npm 官方源（https://registry.npmjs.org/）**，点击 **Install**。完成后，等当前任务结束，完全退出并重新打开 Harness。 > 若找不到切换源的入口，或安装失败，使用[终端安装或本地包安装](docs/INSTALLATION.md#其他安装方式)。 ### 2. 连接 ChatGPT 打开 **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 → 连接 ChatGPT**，点击 **打开授权页面**，在 OpenAI 页面完成登录与授权。返回 Harness 后会自动显示连接状态和可用模型。 ### 3. 开始使用 新建会话，在模型选择器的 **ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT)** 下选择模型。 试着输入：`帮我阅读当前项目，说明它的用途。` 支持图片的模型也可以直接接收会话中添加的图片。 ## 常见问题 **这个插件支持哪个产品？** 仅支持 DeepSeek Harness。DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 和普通聊天桌面客户端不支持安装本插件。支持 Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS；当前实测基线为 0.2.0-rc.2。 **如何在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅？** 安装 `dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.7`，在设置中连接自己的 ChatGPT 账户，再从 ChatGPT plan 中选择模型。无需 API Key，模型权限与额度由账户决定。 **可以直接填 GitHub 地址吗？** 这是源码地址：`https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter`。不同宿主与市场的安装器支持有差异，日常安装建议使用上面的明确包名与版本。 **已经连接，却没有模型？** 点击“刷新模型”，检查当前账户的订阅权限、额度及网络。模型列表以账户实际返回为准。 **如何升级？** 用相同包名安装新版本，然后完全退出并重开 Harness。保留原 Profile 和账户目录即可延续使用。 **如何退出或卸载？** 先在设置页退出账户，再到 Plugins 卸载。[详细说明](docs/PRIVACY.md#断开与卸载)。 ## 了解更多 [思考强度](docs/REASONING.md) · [安装与排错](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [兼容范围](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [数据与隐私](docs/PRIVACY.md) · [版本说明](RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [参与开发](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 会话文本、所选图片和工具结果会发送至 OpenAI。登录凭证保存在本机未加密文件中，具有仅当前用户可读写的权限。本插件是独立社区项目，不隶属于 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek。 ### 插件头像 启用插件后，窗口右下角会显示「大肥鱼指挥 Codex」头像。图片随安装包提供，无需外部图片服务；头像不响应鼠标操作，不遮挡下方控件的点击。停用插件后自动移除。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Reviso for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): publish agent output for human review and find it again from the session
plugins.readme_text:
# reviso-dsh

Reviso for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — the DSH surface of the Reviso family.

| repo | surface |
|---|---|
| `reviso` | product (backend + web) |
| `reviso-agent` | agent skill (any agent, platform-agnostic) |
| `reviso-cli` | CLI |
| **`reviso-dsh`** | DSH host integration (this repo) |

## Status: Phase 1 — visible client face (verified in a live browser)

Implemented, two views:
- Sidebar entry (`sidebar.footer.action`, beside Settings) + `shell.overlay` panel — ALL Reviso documents for the user.
- Session view tab (`conversation.view`, id `reviso-dsh.view`, beside chat | trajectory) — documents produced by THIS session (binding key `session_key = dsh:<sessionId>`, served once the reviso L0 contract lands).
Demo mode (labeled 演示) is the default; fill Server + Token in the panel's
连接设置 to hit a real deployment (auth: `Authorization: Bearer <automation
key or account-agent token>`; the deployment must allow this origin via
`REVISO_CORS_ALLOWLIST`).

Slot/build contract: see docs/client-face-contract.md.

Minimal DSH bundle that loads under the harness. Roadmap:

1. **Phase 0 (here)** — bundle skeleton, load-verified locally.
2. **Phase 1** — Reviso HTTP client: publish/read with `source_kind` +
   `source_session_id` (normalized to `session_key`); requires the L0 contract
   in the `reviso` main repo (`document_sources` sidecar + read APIs).
3. **Phase 2** — Agent Inbox tab + per-session "back to session" openers
   (client-face spike against DSH's browser extension contract).

## Concepts (per DSH docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)

- A **bundle** is an npm package shipping a config layer: `package.json`
  declares `dsh.bundle` → its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts plugin rows that
  reference the package **by name**.
- A **profile** is what a user boots (`dsh --profile <name>`); `dsh plugin`
  maintains it. Layer order: profile bundles → profile patch → home patch →
  `--patch` overlays.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/reviso-dsh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # expect a "# == dsh-reviso" layer
```

## Local dev

Scratch form uses an absolute source path (paths must be absolute):

```yaml
# dev.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: reviso-dsh
      name: '/absolute/path/to/reviso-dsh/index.js'
```

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch ./dev.patch.yml
```

## Contract

The cross-repo contract (Reviso HTTP API + `source_kind` enum
`dsh|claude|codex|cursor|mcp` + `session_key = kind:normalized_id`) is owned by
the `reviso` main repo (L0). This package never talks to Supabase directly.

Tested with dsh `0.1.0-rc.8`.

## See it locally

`sh
pnpm install && pnpm run build:client   # produce lib/client.js
dsh plugin --profile web add /Users/touchskyer/Code/reviso-projects/reviso-dsh
dsh web                                  # Reviso entry sits beside Settings in the sidebar
`

Rollback: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-reviso`.

## License

MIT — same as `reviso-agent` / `reviso-cli`.

# dsh-todo-reminder

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-todo-reminder)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-todo-reminder)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)
![compat](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder/actions/workflows/compat.yml/badge.svg)

DSH 的**全局个人待办**插件 —— 一份跟你所有会话、所有项目都无关的个人清单。

## 功能

- **全局面板**：侧边栏「待办」入口打开，浮在页面中央（不再挂在会话列里）—— 任何会话下
  打开都是同一份内容、同一个位置。新建（标题 / 备注 / 提醒时间 / 提醒样式 / 完成需确认）、
  完成、删除；待办 / 已完成分区展示。Esc 或点空白处关闭。
- **右侧待办条（Dock）**：窗口右缘常驻、可收起；收起时直接显示下一件要做的事
  （到期时间 + 标题），逾期变红；展开可快速添加 / 勾完成 / 稍后提醒；可上下拖动，可关闭。
- **到期提醒**：host 每 5 秒扫描到期任务，经 SSE 实时推到浏览器弹富 toast，动作有
  「完成 / 稍后提醒（分钟数可自定义）/ 忽略」；**切出到别的窗口时转成系统原生通知**。
- **多种提醒样式**：info（蓝）/ success（绿）/ warning（黄）/ danger（红，呼吸动画）。
- **提醒音**：每种样式可单独开关响铃；音量、音色可调；可试听。
- **完成需确认**：任务可开启，点「完成」先弹确认框。
- **Agent 工具**：todo_add / todo_list / todo_complete / todo_snooze / todo_delete。

> 本插件是原来那个「待办 + 会话提醒」二合一插件拆出来的**待办模块**。DSH 会话的
> 「跑完 / 提问 / 审批」提醒已经独立成 **dsh-session-attention**，两者数据、设置、
> 声效文件、接口全部独立，可单独安装、单独卸载。

## 安装

从 npm 装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-todo-reminder    # 桌面端
dsh plugin --profile web     add dsh-todo-reminder    # 浏览器版
```

从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物 `lib/`，克隆后可直接指过去）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录>
```

> 改了源码想重新构建：`npm install && npm run prepack`（host 半 `tsc` → `lib/`，client 半 `tsdown` → `lib/client.js`）。
## 设置与数据

| 项 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 数据文件 | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/todos.json`（待办 + 提醒事件 + 设置，原子写） |
| 自定义提醒音 | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/sound.{mp3,wav,ogg,m4a}` |
| HTTP 接口 | `/api/todo/state`、`/api/todo/events`（SSE）、`/api/todo/sound`、`/api/todo/{add,update,delete,complete,snooze,dismiss-reminder,set-settings}` |

拆分后 `todos.json` 里遗留的 `settings.attention` / `settings.ball` 由本插件忽略（不删）；
它们会被 dsh-session-attention 首次启动时读走做迁移。

## 提醒音怎么走

1. **自定义音效文件优先**：音频解锁后探测 `/api/todo/sound`，命中则解码使用。
2. **内置合成音兜底**：没有文件 / 解码失败时用 WebAudio 现场合成四种音色。
3. **系统通知兜底**：音频尚未解锁时，由系统通知自己出声。

音频解锁靠 document 上的手势监听自动完成（点 DSH 里任何地方即可）。页面内音效在前台/
后台都会响；**页面完全关闭时不会响**，那时只有系统通知，而浏览器通知只能用系统默认音。

## 构建

```bash
npm install          # 只需一次
npm run prepack      # host 半 tsc → lib/；client 半 tsdown → lib/client.js
```

host 半只依赖 `node:` 内置模块（自包含）；client 半经 tsdown 打包为 ModuleLoader 客户端，React 交给宿主运行时。

## 兼容性

本插件依赖 DSH 的一些**内部点**（服务名、事件名、DOM 类名、客户端包格式）。DSH 演进较快，
这些点在版本之间**会变** —— 插件断掉往往不是插件自己的 bug，而是这里变了。所以仓库里带了一个自检脚本：

```bash
npm run check:compat                        # 检查本机已装的 DSH
node scripts/check-compat.mjs --from <dir>  # 检查指定目录（CI 用）
```

实测结果：

| DSH 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2`（当前） | ✅ 15/15 |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2`（下一个） | ✅ 15/15 |

依赖点一览（断哪条、坏哪个功能，脚本输出里都写了）：

| 分类 | 依赖点 |
|---|---|
| 客户端 | `__ModuleLoader__` 加载器格式、`/plugins` 资源路由 |
| 服务 | `uiWorkspace.openSession`、会话列表 `byId` 快照、host 的 `webServer` / `systemPrompt` |
| DOM | 类名含 `sessionRow` / `newSession` / `centerCol` |
| 事件 | `session/event` / `turn/end` / `approval/asked` / `tool/call` |
| 工具 | `ask_user_question` |

**GitHub Actions 每周自动跑一次**（含 alpha 版本），不通过就自动开 issue —— 所以 DSH 更新导致的不兼容
会被提前发现，而不是等用户先撞上。

> 与 [dsh-session-attention](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention) 是各自独立的插件，互不依赖，可单独安装。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: per-conversation token and money accounting — session_cost / list_session_costs tools, the /cost command, and a composer cost pill with per-model rates and DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-cost — 统计每个对话消耗的 token 与金额

DSH 插件（Cordis bundle）· 工具 `session_cost` / `list_session_costs` · 命令 `/cost` · 界面「💰 消耗」药丸

DSH 自己**只记 token、不记钱**：`dsh-token-meter` 的 `tokenUsage` 投影给出精确的 token 桶
（未命中缓存输入 / 命中缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出），但整个自带安装里没有任何文本单价——
唯一带价格的是图片 visual token。本插件补上"金额"这一半，并且把两半都做成
**可按模型分别计价**的账。

```
会话日志（每条 assistant/message 自带 provider/model + usage）
   └─ lib/usage.js   按 attempt 归属到它自己的路由，按 attempt 当时的时刻判断高峰/非高峰（仅峰谷价模型）
        └─ lib/rates.js   查单价表 → 整数最小单位（1e-6）累加
             ├─ 工具 session_cost / list_session_costs   （模型可调，精确到每次调用）
             ├─ 命令 /cost                                （不花 token，直接看）
             └─ 界面 💰 药丸                              （会话级近似，可一键与日志核对）
```

## 数字从哪来（以及哪一半是精确的）

| 数字 | 来源 | 精确度 |
|---|---|---|
| token 桶 | 已落盘的 `assistant/message.data.usage`（缺省回退到流里最后一个 `usage` chunk） | **精确**，与 DSH 自己的 `tokenUsage` 投影逐字节一致（[见验证](#验证)） |
| 路由归属 | 该条 assistant 消息自己的 `message.source.provider/model` | **精确**，中途换模型会分成多行分别计价 |
| 高峰/非高峰 | 该次调用的 `event.time` | **精确到规则**：周一至周五 01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00（按 `offPeakTimezone`，默认 UTC）为高峰，中国法定节假日全天按非高峰；**只对峰谷价模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek` 或 `peakPricing: true`），其余模型全天一个价 |
| 单价 | 本插件的 `rates` 配置 | **取决于你填的对不对**；未配置的模型只统计 token、不计金额，并明确列出来 |
| 💰 药丸 | `tokenUsage` + `modelSelection` 两个投影 | **近似**：整段对话按当前模型计价；换过模型时请点「与日志核对」或看 `/cost` |

缓存写入（`cacheWriteTokens`）DeepSeek 不单独计费，因此默认按普通输入（cache miss）价计价，
可用 `cacheWrite` 覆盖。金额用**整数最小单位**（1e-6，即"微元"）累加，避免长对话里浮点误差；
单位是 `currency` 那一个，不是美元。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 dsh-session-cost 目录下
node install/install.mjs                 # 装进默认 desktop profile（含默认单价表）
node install/install.mjs --dry-run       # 先看会改什么
node install/install.mjs --currency '{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}'   # 若账号按美元计费
node install/install.mjs --uninstall     # 卸载
```

安装做三件事，每件都有 `.dsh-session-cost-<时间戳>.bak` 备份：

1. 把包**实体复制**到 `<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost`（不用符号链接：源目录
   曾被链接清空过一次；实体复制还能让 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的裸导入走 profile 自己的解析路径）
2. profile `package.json`：加 `file:` 依赖，并把包名追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
   （这一步才让它出现在「插件」页的**已安装**里）
3. profile `cordis.patch.yml`：用受管块按 id 覆写两行，写入单价表 / 货币 / 非高峰设置

**装完**：改 `lib/index.js`、`lib/command.js` 等宿主半边 → **完全退出 DSH 再启动**；
改 `lib/client.js`（界面半边）→ 页面**硬刷新**（Ctrl+R）。插件页 → 已安装 →
`@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**，可直接编辑单价表（表单由本包自己渲染，
因为 DSH 只提供 `plugins.row.config` 扩展点、不自带渲染器）。

> 实测差异（本插件开发时踩到的）：**首次**把包加进 profile 会让运行中的 DSH 热重组，
> 宿主侧的工具/命令/路由**立刻可用**；但**插件模块本身不会被重新导入**——之后再改
> `lib/*.js` 并刷新副本，运行中的进程仍在跑旧代码，必须重启 DSH 才会换新。界面半边的
> 插槽注册发生在页面加载时，所以至少要硬刷新一次。

> 另一个实测差异：**DSH 自己开着的沙箱可能只允许写工作区**。这种情况下
> `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` 能写、`<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost\` 却
> `EPERM`——因为前者在允许列表里、后者不在。安装器会逐文件复制并把
> `NOT updated (permission denied): lib/ ...` 明确打出来（而不是假装成功），此时**行已改、
> 模块还是旧的**：换一个能写该目录的权限重跑同一命令即可，不需要退出 DSH。
> 注意这与「文件真的被运行中的 DSH 锁住」（`EBUSY`）是两回事，安装器分开报告。

## 配置字段

**在界面里填单价**（推荐）：插件页 → 已安装 → `@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**。
那一页的「模型单价」是一张**可编辑表格**，每个模型一行，直接输入数字即可：

```
模型（<provider>/<model>）   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash   2     0.04              8    ×
deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro  9     0.3              27    ×
[＋ 添加模型]   留空的「命中缓存 / 缓存写入」= 与未命中同价

模型   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash   ¥2   ¥0.04   ¥2   ¥8      ← 只读预览（跟随 currency）
DeepSeek-V4-Pro       ¥9   ¥0.3    ¥9   ¥27

▸ 高级：直接编辑 rates JSON
```

- **未命中、输出必填**；命中缓存 / 缓存写入留空 = 与未命中同价（DeepSeek 的缓存写入不单独计费）；
- **「＋ 添加模型」**加一行，每行的 **×** 删掉该行（至少留一行）；
- 表格只改这四列，**同一模型上的其它字段会被保留**（`label`、`offPeakMultiplier`、
  `inputOffPeak` 等），不会因为你在界面上改了一个价就把高级设置悄悄删掉；
- 模型名必须写成 `<provider>/<model>`，**可以直接复制下面只读预览里的键名**；
- 下面是**只读预览**：按当前 `currency` 标注单位，把每个模型的四个单价列全，一眼能看出
  「我填的价会不会被这么算」；
- 最下面的**「高级」**是可折叠的 `rates` JSON 原文——要写表格没有暴露的字段
  （`inputOffPeak` 之类）时用它；两处是同一个值的两个视角，改哪边都会同步另一边的表格；
- **保存前会校验**：缺 `input`/`output`、值不是数字、模型名没有 `/`、模型名重复，都会**拒绝保存**
  并指出是**哪一行哪个字段**——因为 Host 挂载时会拒绝这种表，那会让整个读数不显示，
  所以宁可在这里拦住。

字段清单（表格没覆盖的部分用「高级」直接写）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `rates` | DeepSeek 官方价（见下） | JSON：`"<provider>/<model>"` → 每 100 万 token 的单价，**单位与 `currency` 一致** |
| `currency` | `{"symbol":"¥","code":"CNY","perUsd":1}` | 展示货币；`perUsd` 是 1 美元兑多少该货币 |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | `0.5` | 非高峰价 = 高峰价 × 该系数，**只对「峰谷价」的模型生效**（见 `peakPricing`） |
| `offPeakTimezone` | `UTC` | 判断高峰时段的 IANA 时区 |
| `offPeakHolidays` | 空 = 用内置清单 | 中国法定节假日（`YYYY-MM-DD`，逗号分隔），这些日期全天按非高峰价 |
| `dshHome` | 空 | 空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退回 `~/.dsh` |

单价表每个条目可用的字段：

| 字段 | 必填 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | ✅ | 未命中缓存的输入价 |
| `output` | ✅ | 输出价 |
| `cacheRead` | | 命中缓存的输入价；缺省 = `input` |
| `cacheWrite` | | 缓存写入价；缺省 = `input`（DeepSeek 不单独计费） |
| `label` | | 界面/报告里显示的名字，如 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` |
| `peakPricing` | | 该模型是否有高峰/非高峰两档价；**不填时按键名判断：含 `deepseek` 才是 `true`，其余一律 `false`（固定价）** |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | | 该模型自己的非高峰系数，覆盖全局值；只对 `peakPricing: true` 的模型生效 |
| `inputOffPeak` / `cacheReadOffPeak` / `cacheWriteOffPeak` / `outputOffPeak` | | 直接写死非高峰价，覆盖系数；同样只对峰谷价模型生效 |

**峰谷价只属于 DeepSeek**。这是实测踩到的第二个坑：插件原来把非高峰折扣套在了**每一条**已配置
单价的路由上，于是本机真实存在的 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`（只有一个固定价）被算成
半价，面板还理直气壮地写着「非高峰 ×0.5」——那个模型根本没有低谷时段。现在的规则是：

- 键名含 `deepseek` 的路由 → 峰谷价（`deepseek-official/*`、`deepseek-account/*`）；
- 其它一切路由 → 固定价，全天按表里的价格，面板显示「固定价」；
- 想覆盖就在该条目写 `peakPricing: true`（比如 DeepSeek 模型走了别的 provider 名，
  或某个转售商也分时计价）或 `peakPricing: false`（比如 DeepSeek 模型被按平价转售）。

实测（本机全部会话日志 + 已装配置）：修复前 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`
合计 **¥0.945**，修复后 **¥1.8907**，正好差一倍；同一份数据里三条 DeepSeek 路由金额
一分不变（¥48.9713 / ¥10.5830 / ¥0.523）——也就是这次修正没有动到本来就正确的部分。

默认表按 [DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) 的**高峰价**
填写，单位是**人民币元 / 百万 token**——因为 DeepSeek 账号本身以人民币计费、余额也按人民币变动。
非高峰由 `offPeakMultiplier: 0.5` 折半（官方非高峰价为高峰价的一半）：

```json
{
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-flash": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "input": 2, "cacheRead": 0.04, "output": 8 },
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4-Pro", "input": 9, "cacheRead": 0.3, "output": 27 }
}
```

> **为什么默认是人民币，而不是美元**：这是实测踩到的坑。DeepSeek 的官方文档同时给出美元价
> （Flash 高峰 `$0.3 / $0.006 / $1.2`）。早期版本照抄美元价、`currency` 写 `$`，于是同一个
> 会话显示 `$1.1262`，而平台余额实际扣了 **¥9.06**——看起来像"统计少了一个数量级"，其实是
> **币种错了**，而且因为不能拿中美汇率当 1 用，误差正好是汇率倍数。把单价表和 `currency` 都
> 换成账号自己的人民币口径后，同一个会话算出 **¥4.9610**，与平台对得上。
>
> 如果你的账号是美元计费（或你想看美元），把 `rates` 换成美元价、`currency` 换成
> `{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}` 即可——**两处必须同时改**，只改一个就会差一个汇率。

**高峰时段**（官方脚注）：周一至周五 `01:00–04:00` 与 `06:00–10:00` **UTC**，
**不含中国法定节假日**——节假日全天按非高峰。窗口是规则，节假日是日历，所以后者是
`offPeakHolidays` 数据：内置 2026 年清单，**每年 11 月国务院公布次年安排后需要更新**
（不更新只会把工作日节假日按高峰算，即偏高，不会偏低）。留空就用内置清单，填了就完全替换。

这个窗口**只对峰谷价的模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek`，或显式 `peakPricing: true`）；
固定价模型不看时间，也就不会因为节假日/时段变化而算错。`offPeakHolidays` 与
`offPeakTimezone` 只在前者身上起作用。

价格会变，**请以官方页面为准**自行更新。

## 用法

### 1. 界面：消耗药丸 + 明细面板

对话输入框上方（DSH 自带统计药丸那一排）会多一个胶囊：

```
● ¥0.0138 · 129k / 1.00M ⌄        ← 圆点：灰=空闲，绿=正在跑；未配置价格时描边转警告色
● ¥10.3089 · 284k / 1.00M ⌄       ← 金额是本会话（或家族）的花费，token 数是「当前上下文」
● ¥8.2288 [含派生 4] · 144k / 1.05M ⌄   ← 派生出过子代理时：金额是「本会话 + 派生会话」
```

**token 数字刻意用 DSH 自己的口径**：`已用 / 窗口`，也就是「下一次调用要发送的长度」。
这是 DSH 自带统计显示的那个数，用它才不会让人以为两边对不上（见下面「三个 token 数」）。

**只要这个对话派生出过子代理 / workflow agent，胶囊的金额就是整个家族的花费**，并在后面
标出包含了几个派生会话——否则它会看起来比实际便宜（子代理是独立会话、独立计费，它们的
token 根本不在本会话的 `tokenUsage` 投影里，所以这个数必须问宿主）。鼠标悬停会写清全部口径：

```
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · 本会话 ¥5.6821 + 4 个派生会话 ¥2.5467 · 家族合计 ¥8.2288
  · 整段对话累计计费 243,629,270 tokens（含缓存重读） · 本次新增 1,372,099 tokens · 当前上下文 144k / 1.05M
```

**路由一律写成 `<provider>/<model>`**（悬停提示、面板头部、`/cost`、工具返回都是），
因为 `rates` 就是按这个键写的：它指的就是你要去编辑的那一条，而且同一个模型名可能被两个
provider 提供，只写模型名分不出是哪一条。配置过的 `label` 只在有空间的地方补在后面，
如面板头部的 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）`。

本会话自身的金额始终在同一行里，所以与 DSH 自带统计对照时不会失去参照。

点开是一个面板（点击外部或按 Esc 关闭；展开状态记在 `localStorage`，刷新后保持）：

```
对话消耗        deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）  [非高峰 ×0.5]
对话消耗        our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free                  [固定价]   ← 这条路只有一个价，不分峰谷
██████████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 金额构成条（本会话自身的构成）
■ 未命中 20%   ■ 命中缓存 2%   ■ 输出 78%      ← 图例：每种 token 的金额占比

输入 · 未命中缓存        1,000,000        ¥2.00
输入 · 命中缓存          1,000,000        ¥0.02

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-phone-inbox

The session's inbound phone (WeChat bridge) attachment inbox: list the attachments **this conversation** actually received, and adopt one into the workspace on demand.

## The problem this closes

`dsh-wechat` saves inbound phone media to `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile/` — outside the session workspace — and writes the absolute path into a plain text block. Two consequences follow, and neither is visible to the user:

1. **Workspace-confined tools cannot read it.** `dsh-data-quality` rejects any path that escapes the session workspace (`path-escape`), so "I sent you a CSV, profile it" fails even though the file is right there.
2. **The file name is destroyed.** The bridge names the file `${Date.now()}-${rand4hex}-${name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_")}`, so `材料.csv` lands on disk as `__.csv`. The user cannot recognize their own file.

`dsh-phone-inbox` adds no new channel and copies nothing by default. It makes the session's own inbound list addressable, and it restores the name the bridge mangled — from the `[收到文件: <name>]` marker the bridge already writes.

## What you get

| Tool | Question it answers |
|---|---|
| `inbox_list` | "Where is the file I just sent you from my phone?" |
| `inbox_adopt` | "Put it somewhere my workspace-confined tools can read it." |

Both tools are registered by the function plugin, so they appear in the model's tool list as soon as the bundle row is mounted.

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. Mount the plugin (a bundle row in the target profile)
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
```

Then, in a session that received a phone attachment:

```text
inbox_list                                   # the paths this session received
inbox_adopt { "path": "<the path from inbox_list>" }
```

`inbox_adopt` returns `relativePath` (for example `phone-inbox/材料.csv`). Pass **that** to a workspace-confined tool such as `data_profile`; pass the original host path only to consumers that accept any absolute path.

## Install & uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-phone-inbox
```

The plugin has **no runtime dependencies** (`dependencies` is empty). Its only peers are the host packages it is built against; see the `peerDependencies` block in `package.json`.

## Compatibility

| Engine | Range |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-alpha.1` |

The host peer range is the ecosystem's canonical six-clause OR range (see `dsh-plugin-kit/data/peer-range.json`). The host evaluates `peerDependencies` at preflight and **silently disables** a plugin row whose range does not admit the running version, so a wrong range looks like "the plugin mounted and does nothing". `engines.dsh` is declarative only — the host does not read it.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; the table lists the default. See `cordis.patch.yml` for the same values with inline comments.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` mounts no service and no tools. |
| `inboxDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile` | Directory the bridge drops inbound media into. Empty derives the bridge's own default; set it when the bridge's `storageDir` was moved. |
| `maxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries `inbox_list` returns. The MVP contract is "the session's most recent few". |
| `provider` | `session` | Which registered provider answers: `session` (this conversation's own messages) or `tempdir` (`session` plus a scan of `inboxDir`). |
| `allowTempdirScan` | `false` | Enables the directory scan at all. Off because `inboxDir` is global. |
| `tempdirScanMaxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries a scan may contribute. |
| `tempdirScanMaxAgeMs` | `3600000` | Age ceiling for a scanned file; `0` disables the filter. |
| `markers` | see below | Marker wording per media kind, as `RegExp` sources. |
| `defaultSubdir` | `phone-inbox` | Workspace subdirectory `inbox_adopt` writes into. |
| `restoreOriginalName` | `true` | Use the sender's recovered original name as the adopted file name. |
| `writeChannel` | `auto` | `auto` (fs service for text, node:fs otherwise) · `fs` (host fs service only) · `node` (bytes directly). |
| `registerAttachment` | `false` | Also register adopted bytes as a durable host attachment. Attachment objects are never garbage-collected. |

The `markers` default wording, per media kind — each value is a `RegExp` source whose **first capture group is the path**:

- `image.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.path` — `` (?:文件已保存到|文件路径):\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.name` — `` \[收到文件:\s*([^\]\r\n]+)\] ``
- `video.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``

Marker wording is a **soft contract** with the bridge: it writes the path into prose, and the prose can change between bridge releases without notice. The patterns are configuration precisely so a wording change is a config edit rather than a plugin release.

## Tools & surfaces

```ts
inbox_list({
  limit?: number,            // default: config.maxItems
  includeTempdir?: boolean,  // only honoured when allowTempdirScan is true
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, source, inboxDir, items[], attachments, deriveMessages, emptyReason?, emptyDetail?, tempdirScan, unresolvedAttachmentBlocks }`, or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

```ts
inbox_adopt({
  path: string,              // required: exactly what inbox_list reported
  name?: string,             // default: the recovered original name
  subdir?: string,           // default: config.defaultSubdir
  channel?: 'auto' | 'fs' | 'node',
  overwrite?: boolean,       // default false: a duplicate gets a -1 suffix
  register?: boolean,        // default: config.registerAttachment
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, item }` with `hostPath`, `workspacePath`, `relativePath`, `bytes`, `sha256`, `copyMethod`, `nameRestored`, `sourceLeafName`, and `attachmentId`/`attachmentHostPath` when registered; or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

The plugin also appends one system-prompt section (`phone-inbox`, order 320) so the model knows the capability exists, and subscribes to `session/event` for `user/message` observation. Neither is required for correctness: the history read is authoritative on every call.

## Permissions & data

- **Reads** `inboxDir` and the calling session's own messages. Nothing else.
- **Writes** only inside the session workspace (`path.resolve` + a separator-aware containment check), and only when `inbox_adopt` is called.
- **Refuses** a source path that is not under `inboxDir`, a `subdir` that escapes the workspace, and a name that could traverse. The `path` argument comes from the model and is never trusted.
- **Does not scan** the shared inbox directory unless `allowTempdirScan` is explicitly enabled; when it does, every entry it contributes is stamped `source: "tempdir"`.
- **Never overwrites** silently. A duplicate destination gets a `-1`, `-2`, … suffix unless `overwrite: true`.
- **Registers nothing** as a durable attachment unless asked; registration copies bytes into the host's attachment store, which has no garbage collection.

## Security boundaries

- Reads are not fenced by the host's fs sandbox (the fence wraps only `writeText`/`editText`), so this plugin enforces its own containment on **both** ends of the copy.
- The `fs` write channel goes through `ctx.fs.writeText` with the session-scoped sandbox policy, so a confining backend fences it exactly as it fences the `write` tool. `node` bypasses that fence by construction; it exists because `ctx.fs` has no byte-write API. The returned `copyMethod` always says which one ran.
- `auto` prefers the fs service for text and falls back to `node:fs`; the fallback reason is recorded and the channel is reported, never implied.
- The tempdir scan cannot prove which conversation a file belongs to. That is why it is off by default and why its items carry their own `source`.
- The bridge's inbox directory is not guaranteed to be private (a bridge refactor removed the explicit `0o700`/`0o600` handling). This plugin does not assume otherwise.

## Known limitations

- **A path containing a literal space is truncated** at the space by the default marker wording. The capture is `(\S+)` because that is what stops it f

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp-lite

**Config-only bridge from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP).**

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

It mounts the MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness and points it at the upstream Windows-MCP server over stdio. The whole integration is [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) — about 25 lines, no JavaScript, and you can read it to the end before you install it.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ mcp__windows__Snapshot / Click / Type / ...
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (ships with DeepSeek Harness)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UI Automation tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What this deliberately does not do

These are the design decisions, not a missing-feature list:

- **No Host plugin.** There is no `index.js`. Nothing of ours runs inside your harness process.
- **No web routes.** This plugin adds no HTTP endpoint, so it adds no unauthenticated attack surface and no reason to keep your web host on loopback beyond what you already chose.
- **No state file.** No `~/.dsh/...state.json`, no browser storage keys.
- **No installer that writes to your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream server *in your own terminal*, and never edits a profile patch for you.
- **No runtime dependency and no build step.** `dependencies` is empty; there is nothing to compile and no `allowBuilds` approval to grant.
- **No absolute path for your machine.** The bridge invokes `uvx` from `PATH`; a test in this repo fails the build if a machine-specific path appears in a published file.
- **No `peerDependencies`.** The row *names* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; it never imports it, and DSH resolves shipped packages from its own installation. This follows DSH's own `templates/mcp` bundle shape, which declares none. A peer range would be a hard activation gate whose SemVer prerelease rules silently reject valid hosts; `engines.dsh` declares the host range for the storefront instead.
- **No `screenshots.json`.** There is no interface to photograph. Declaring artwork for a configuration file would be decoration, not evidence; the storefront falls back to whatever it can extract.

If you want an in-app dependency installer, a default-off "Computer Use" toggle, or a doctor tool, other plugins in this ecosystem provide those. This one trades them for being small enough to audit in one screen — which matters more than usual for a plugin that hands over your keyboard, mouse and screen.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.** The upstream server is Windows-only.
- **DeepSeek Harness with the in-box MCP client bridge.** Declared range: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; the author verified this plugin on **0.2.0-rc.2** (desktop).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH.** `uvx` starts the upstream server and builds its isolated environment. If you installed uv with its official installer, this is already true.
- Optional: **a model that accepts image input**, if you want `Screenshot` to arrive as a real image. Without it the bridge degrades the image to a text diagnostic; `Snapshot` returns plain text and needs no vision at all.

## Install

From the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter one of

```text
dsh-windows-mcp-lite                                # npm package
github:sheilacraig/dsh-windows-mcp-lite             # GitHub repository
C:\path\to\a\local\checkout                         # absolute path
```

From a CLI-owned profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-windows-mcp-lite
```

The Electron desktop profile belongs to the app; install through its plugin panel there.

Then restart DSH, so the new patch layer composes at startup.

## First run is the slow one

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for the upstream server the first time, which downloads a few tens of megabytes of Python dependencies. On a slow link that is minutes, and the bridge gives up on the initial connection long before that; after the dependencies are cached, startup is quick.

Do it outside the harness instead, where there is no timeout:

```sh
npm run prewarm
```

The script runs `uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve --exclude-tools ...` — the same argv the bridge uses — speaks `initialize` + `tools/list` to it, prints the server identity, the time it took, and the exact tool list, then exits. It is the same process the bridge will start, so a successful run means the harness side has nothing left to download or discover. With the environment warm, the author's run reached `initialize` in 2.1 s.

## What the model gets

**16 tools**, named `mcp__windows__<Tool>`. Upstream 0.8.8 publishes 21; this plugin excludes five by default (see [Least privilege](#least-privilege-by-default)).

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Screenshot` | Screen capture with cursor position and window list |
| `Snapshot` | Full desktop state: accessibility tree, interactive elements, scrollable regions |
| `DisplayInventory` | Display layout, work areas, DPI |
| `Click`, `Move`, `Scroll` | Mouse input, including explicit drag |
| `Type`, `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `Wait`, `WaitFor` | Fixed delay, or poll the UI until a condition holds |
| `MultiSelect`, `MultiEdit` | Bulk selection / bulk text entry |
| `Clipboard` | Read and set clipboard content |
| `Notification` | Windows toast notifications |
| `App` | Launch an application, resize or focus a window |
| `ControlStatus` | Who owns the desktop right now — upstream cannot exclude this one |

## Verify

1. Run `npm run prewarm` once (above). It proves the server and the pinned version.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory`. It only reads display geometry — it does not click or type.
3. Then `mcp__windows__Snapshot` for the accessibility tree as text.

## Least privilege by default

`--exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape` — five upstream tools stay off, because DeepSeek Harness already owns shell, file, registry and process access under its own approval policy and sandbox. Enabling upstream's copies would add a second path to the same capabilities with none of those controls.

To change the set, override the row in your profile patch (see below). Removing `--exclude-tools` restores all 21 tools.

## Configuration

Every default lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change one, override the row in **your profile's** patch — do not edit the installed copy:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: windows-mcp-lite
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape,App"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
```

Two things about that override, both of which cost people time:

- **A patch replaces the entire `config` object; it does not deep-merge.** Every key you leave out is a key you delete. `serverName` and `transport` are required, `command` is required for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`.
- **`serverName` decides every tool name** (`mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`). Changing it renames the whole tool set and invalidates prompt-cache prefixes.

**Only one Windows-MCP bridge per profile.** Two rows using the same `serverName` conflict, and the second one fails at load. Disable any other Windows-MCP plugin in the same profile before enabling this one.

Prefer a pre-installed interpreter over `uvx`? `uv tool install windows-mcp`, then set `command: windows-mcp` with `args: [serve, --exclude-tools, ...]`. Prefer a resident HTTP server? Switch `transport` to `streamable-http` and give `url` — note that the HTTP form has no `env`, so telemetry and flash settings then belong to how you start the server.

## Security

Installing this gives an agent your mouse, keyboard, clipboard and screen, through a process that runs with your user rights. Judge it as

# @suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor

```
⚠️ 本仓库是**自动生成的发布镜像**，每次发布都会整体覆盖 `main`。
**唯一事实来源 / single source of truth:** [Suxeca/dsh-plugin → packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor)
请勿在本仓库提交代码或 PR —— 改为修改源仓库中的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，本仓库的内容会被下一次发布覆盖。
```

**本仓库只发布可安装产物**（`lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`locale/`、`package.json`），**不含 `src/` 与 `tests/`**：审计器要检测的那些标记（安装钩子名、宿主进程 API、越狱口令等）在本仓库的产物中一律由运行时拼装生成（源仓库 `src/tokens.ts`），所以任何静态扫描都不会在本仓库里读到它自己的检测表 —— 否则它会扫到自己、把自己判成 CRITICAL（F 级），并让安装门禁对使用者误报。源码与唯一事实来源仍在源仓库。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生插件：基于 CMU StarScout 启发式指标审计 GitHub 假星 / 水军 / 空壳仓库，并对 DSH 插件做供应链投毒与敏感权限静态预检。

## 安装 / Install

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor
```

无需构建：`lib/` 已预编译随仓库发布（prebuilt）。包名 `@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，由 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明装配。

## 功能 / What it does

- **假星与互动比率审计** — Fork/Star、Watcher/Star 比率异常检测，含大仓（>50k stars）通知疲劳校准与豁免模型。
- **空壳与脉冲刷量** — 高星但代码体积 < 30 KB 的空壳仓库、活跃跨度不足 2 天的增星脉冲、0-Issue 异常增星（维护者关闭 Issues 时豁免）。
- **点星水军抽样** — 并发抽检最新 Stargazers 的 Profile，识别「三无空白号」与「新注册闪电水军」。
- **供应链投毒预检** — 经 GitHub Raw CDN 零配额静态拉取 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`，识别高危安装钩子（远程下载、`eval`、混淆、凭据窃取）与 DSH 敏感权限（密钥服务注入、插件管理服务、宿主进程 API、工具执行前置钩子）。
- **安装拦截门禁** — 通过工具执行前置钩子（pre-execution hook）监听插件安装动作与 `bash` 中的 `git clone` / `npm install github:...`，命中风险时弹出 DSH 原生审批卡片。

## 配置项 / Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: repo-auditor
      name: '@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor'
      config:
        token: ""               # GitHub PAT（可选）
        sampleSize: 5           # 水军账号抽样数量
        enableInstallGate: true # 安装拦截门禁开关
```

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | `string` | `""` | GitHub Personal Access Token（可选）。留空时按四级顺序自动探测：`config.token` → DSH 凭据服务 → 环境变量 `GITHUB_TOKEN` → 本地 `~/.bashrc` / `~/.env` / `.env`。未鉴权时受 60 次/小时配额限制，鉴权后为 5000 次/小时。 |
| `sampleSize` | `number` | `5` | 水军账号抽样数量；仅在仓库一阶指标可疑（评分 < 85）时才触发抽样，用于保护 API 配额。 |
| `enableInstallGate` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否启用工具执行前置钩子（双轨安全拦截门禁：星标信度低 或 供应链/敏感权限中高风险 → 弹卡审批）。 |

紧急逃生通道 / escape hatch：在命令前加环境变量 `SKIP_REPO_`＋`AUDIT=1`（拼接后即为跳过标记）可跳过安装门禁。

## 出处与致谢 / Attribution

启发式指标来自 CMU 论文 **"Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars in GitHub: A Growing Spiral of Popularity Contagion, Suspicious Promotion, and Unwanted Projects"**（StarScout）— [arXiv:2412.13459](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13459)。本插件是 DSH / Cordis 架构下的原生重实现，与论文作者无隶属关系。

## 构建与来源 / Build & source

本仓库为预编译产物，安装无需构建。源码与开发文档位于 [Suxeca/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin) 的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`；发布流程见该仓库的 `scripts/release-auditor.sh`。

## 许可 / License

MIT License — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。该文件由发布脚本从源仓库根目录自动复制，与 `package.json` 的 `license` 字段保持一致。

# 我的 DSH 插件清单

此文档列举我个人在 DeepSeek Harness 上使用/维护的 out-of-tree 插件。

| 插件 | 为什么需要它 | profile 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-local-policy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-local-policy) | 它以纯 patch 捆绑（无代码）施加本地部署策略：把框架默认的 web 搜索提供方从 DeepSeek 切换为通用 HTTP 提供方，并禁用 DeepSeek 官方集成与 OTel 会话上报。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（patch 引用的 entry id 在该独立树中不存在） |
| [`dsh-logger-channels`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-logger-channels) | 它给操作者提供框架与全部插件 `ctx.logger` 输出的可见出口：向 cordis 注册命名通道（stderr/stdout/file，file 通道纯大小轮转），因为宿主只自带内存环形缓冲，没有它日志只进内存。 | ✅ web；其余长驻 profile 原理上可兼容——未验证 |
| [`@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin`](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking) | 它给 agent 提供由 OpenViking 支撑的长期记忆：跨会话读写记忆，并在共享同一 OpenViking 的 profile 之间传递上下文。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal（MCP client 可用性未验证） |
| [`dsh-timer`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-timer) | 它给 profile 提供进程内定时任务，语义对齐 systemd.timer，每次运行创建一个新 agent 会话执行任务 prompt。 | ✅ web；⚠️ headless（30s tick 调度器在一次性进程中无意义）；✅ sdk/acp（长驻进程）；❌ sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-email`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-email) | 它让 agent 能读写邮件：对 IMAP/SMTP 账号提供列目录、搜索、读取、标记、保存附件与发送/回复/转发，并支持新邮件事件触发，使 agent 能实时响应来信。 | ✅ 全部 profile（软读取、优雅降级）；⚠️ headless（IDLE 触发在一次性进程中无意义） |
| [`dsh-ntfy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-ntfy) | 它给 agent 提供推送通知出口：一次工具调用即把消息发布到 ntfy topic，使作业结果、告警与报告能送达操作者设备或任意订阅该 topic 的应用。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-webhook-dispatcher`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-webhook-dispatcher) | 它给 profile 提供入站 webhook 入口：端点路由挂在框架主 web server 上，外部投递经 method 门控、token 鉴权、请求体大小限制与每端点队列/并发约束后，派发为受控 trigger 会话，使外部系统能触发 agent。 | ✅ web；其余 profile 需组合 `dsh-host-webserver` |
| [`dsh-surfing-plugin`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-surfing-plugin) (forked) | 它为 agent 的联网能力提供后端：允许其接入基于 SearXNG 的搜索与基于 Crawl4AI 的页面抓取。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（无 base web_search） |
| [`dsh-tts`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-tts) | 它让 agent 能合成语音：允许其接入任意 OpenAI 兼容 TTS 后端。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-imagegen`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-imagegen) | 它让 agent 能生成图像：单个 `imagegen` 工具接入任意 OpenAI 兼容图像后端并渲染图像，并可检查已配置后端及其实时状态。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot) (forked) | 它给 profile 提供 QQ IM 通道：维持与 QQ 开放平台的 WS 长连接，处理 QQ 消息的收发与 bot 生命周期，使 agent 能经 QQ 与用户实时交互。 |  ✅ web；❌ headless（一次性进程 + 交互式 QR 绑定）；✅ sdk/acp/sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-qqbot-send`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot-send) | 它让 agent 能主动把文本、Markdown 或文件附件发送到任意 QQ 目标（私聊/群/频道/公会 DM）；独立调用 QQ 开放平台 REST API，因此可以在没有 qqbot 网关的 profile 中单独挂载。 |  ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal |

图例：✅ 兼容 / ⚠️ 可组成功能降级 / ❌ 不兼容 / ❓ 未验证。(forked) = 个人分叉版本。

---

注：除非另有说明，以上插件的自维护版本均使用 QWen3.8-27B groupwise-int 在 DeepSeek Harness 上通过 “Vibe Coding” 产出。软件按“原样”提供，不提供任何形式的明示或暗示的担保。

plugins.description: A hotkey binder plugin for dsh, allows user to bind specific keys to trigger dictation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dictation-hotkey

Press-to-talk dictation for the DSH Web composer. Hold a key combination, speak,
release — DSH's own speech engine transcribes it and the text lands in the
composer.

The plugin adds **no second recognizer**: it drives the speech Remote that DSH
already ships with its voice-input bundle (local SenseVoice, CPU) and inserts the
result through the official composer actions.

```
hold Ctrl+Shift+Space ──▶ speak ──▶ release
        │
        ├─ microphone capture in the page (getUserMedia + AudioWorklet, muted output)
        ├─ encoded as the canonical 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV the Remote requires
        ├─ ctx.remote.speech.transcribe()      ← official speech Remote (SenseVoice)
        └─ inputActions.insertText() / submit() ← official composer
```

## What it does

- **Push to talk**: `hold` (record while held) or `toggle` (press to start, press
  to stop) trigger modes.
- **Fill or send**: insert the transcript for review, or submit it immediately.
- **Reuses DSH's engine**: the same local SenseVoice provider the official
  microphone button uses — no extra process, model download, or cloud API.
- **Composer-native insertion**: text is spliced into the live draft through
  `inputActions.insertText`, so the caret, references, and attachments survive.
- **Configurable per browser**: hotkey, mode, send behaviour, beeps, and
  diagnostics live in a popover on the composer pill (`localStorage`).
- **Works on the new-conversation screen too**: with no session open there is no
  composer draft to splice into, so the transcript is pasted into the focused
  composer as a normal edit, and the pill returns with the first session.
- **Diagnosable**: optional per-keystroke log with audio level, audio length, and
  inference time, which separates "nothing was picked up" from "the recognizer
  missed it".

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or a compatible release, Web profile.
- The official **voice input** bundle enabled (plugin manager → 语音输入). It
  provides the speech engine; without it the pill reports that no recognizer is
  mounted.

## Install

```sh
# from a checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-dictation-hotkey

# or straight from git (no clone, no build: the bundle is committed)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey
```

Then reload the Web UI. The bundle is committed at `client/dist/client.js`, so a
checkout works without a build step.

Updating later: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey`
again and restart `dsh web` — a profile keeps its own copy of the installed
package, so pushing to GitHub does not update an already-installed profile by
itself.

## Use

A **🎙 Dictation** pill appears under the composer:

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Hold `Ctrl+Shift+Space`, speak, release | Transcript inserted into the composer |
| Click the pill | Settings: hotkey (press the keys to capture), fill ↔ send, hold ↔ toggle, beeps, diagnostics |

Releasing **any** key of the combination ends the recording, so there is no need
to lift them together.

On the home screen (no session yet) the pill is absent — the composer dock only
exists inside a session — but the hotkey still works: the controller stays armed
through a root-scope seat and the transcript is pasted into the focused composer.
Auto-send is skipped there, so sending stays your own keystroke.

## Settings

Stored per browser under `localStorage` key `dsh-dictation-hotkey.settings`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hotkey` | `Ctrl+Shift+Space` | `+`-separated combination; `Space`, `F9`, `Alt+~`, letters and digits are understood |
| `mode` | `hold` | `hold` = record while held, `toggle` = press to start/stop |
| `autoSend` | `false` | Submit the draft as soon as the transcript is inserted |
| `beep` | `true` | Short tones for start, stop, and failure |
| `language` | *(empty)* | Recognition language hint; empty follows the DSH speech settings |
| `providerId` | *(empty)* | Speech provider id; empty uses the deployment default |
| `minRecordMs` | `150` | Presses shorter than this are rejected with a visible notice |
| `tailMs` | `180` | Audio kept after release, so a fast release does not clip a syllable |
| `maxRecordSeconds` | `60` | Safety stop |
| `debug` | `false` | Keep the keystroke log |

## Diagnostics

Enable **诊断日志** in the popover; each keystroke then records a structured entry,
mirrored to the DevTools console and kept as a 20-entry ring buffer in
`localStorage` (`dsh-dictation-hotkey.log`, copy/clear buttons in the popover).

| `event` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `start` | Microphone ready — `micStartMs`, triggering keys `heldCodes` |
| `stop` | Released — `heldMs`, `tailMs` |
| `ok` | Recognized — `audioSeconds`, `inferenceMs`, `chars`, `peakDb` |
| `empty-transcript` | Engine returned nothing — carries `peakDb`; `quiet: true` means the recording itself was near-silent |
| `skip` | Rejected by a threshold: `shorter than minRecordMs`, `empty audio`, `speech remote absent` |
| `transcribe-failed` / `mic-failed` / `insert-conflict` / `finish-threw` | Corresponding failure |

`peakDb > -45` with an empty transcript points at the recognizer (adjust
`language`); `peakDb < -45` means that take carried no usable sound.

## Development

```sh
npm run build     # build client/dist/client.js (esbuild)
npm run verify    # contract check: the bundle only touches injected services
npm test          # behaviour suite: fake microphone + recognizer
```

`verify.mjs` exists because Cordis throws when a plugin reads a service it did
not declare (`cannot get property "slots" without inject`) while the Web shell
only prints `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` — a diagnostic dead end this
plugin hit once, now a build-time check. `test-release.mjs` covers sloppy release
order, double taps, sub-threshold presses, empty transcripts, and auto-send.

## How it is wired

| Piece | Where |
|---|---|
| Hotkey, microphone, WAV encoding, state | `client/src/{index,controller,hotkey,audio,settings,ui}.js` |
| Composer seat (session-scoped) | `conversation.composer.dock` slot |
| Session-less seat | headless component in the root-scope `shell.overlay` slot |
| Recognition | `ctx.remote.speech.transcribe` — official speech Remote |
| Host half | `host/index.js`, intentionally a no-op (`apply() {}`) |
| Bundle layer | `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row |

The host half deliberately has no `@deepseek-ai/*` import and no service access:
a profile installs this package through a link, which resolves no dependencies for
it, so a host-side import would abort activation with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and
DSH would refuse to boot the Web GUI.

## Limitations

- Keys are handled while the DSH page is focused. A key pressed with another
  window in front never reaches the plugin; system-wide support needs an OS-level
  helper and is not implemented.
- Microphone permission is granted for the DSH origin. The first ever use may
  require clicking the official microphone button once.
- Recording is capped by `maxRecordSeconds` and by the Remote's own audio limits.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 AndyYang12345

plugins.description: DSH Web plugin: replace the composer reasoning-effort picker with an inline slider card.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reasoning-slider

把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里的 **推理等级** 选择，从「点开二级菜单再点一行」改成一张 **卡片式滑块**。

| 浅色 | 深色 |
| --- | --- |
| ![浅色主题](docs/preview-light.png) | ![深色主题](docs/preview-dark.png) |

## 特性

- **滑块选档**：卡片底部一条轨道，蓝色填充 + 白色圆形滑块，未到达的档位用圆点标出。
- **三种操作方式**：拖拽滑块、点击轨道任意位置、键盘 `←` `→` `↑` `↓` / `Home` / `End`。
- **一键重置**：卡片右上角回到该模型的默认档；当前已是默认档时按钮置灰。
- **大字档位 + 说明**：卡片正中显示当前档位名称（`Off` / `Low` / `High` / `Max` …），下方是该档位的说明文字。
- **触发按钮上的刻度条**：不打开菜单也能一眼看出当前档位。
- **模型二级菜单保留**：分组、搜索、勾选、加载失败重试都在，只换成同一套卡片样式。
- **跟随明暗主题**：全部使用 DSH 设计令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色 / 深色自动适配；文案中英文自动切换。
- **不动官方插件**：官方 `ui-model-selection` 照常加载，它的 `modelDirectories` 服务和 `/model` 指令弹窗都能继续用。

![输入框里的触发按钮](docs/trigger.png)

## 安装

安装后 **刷新一次浏览器页面**（浏览器半边是在页面加载时注入的）。

### 方式一：插件页（推荐）

打开 DSH Web → **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴：

```
github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
```

### 方式二：命令行

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
```

也接受完整地址：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider`

装好后插件会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → 已安装** 列表里，开关默认打开。

### 方式三：预构建 tarball

不想让 pnpm 从源码取包的话，用 release 里附带的预构建包（地址固定，不带版本号，不会随发版失效）：

```
https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider/releases/latest/download/dsh-reasoning-slider.tgz
```

同样粘到 **添加插件** 里，或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider/releases/latest/download/dsh-reasoning-slider.tgz
```

### 方式四：本地源码（开发用）

把仓库克隆到任意位置，然后链接进 profile：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-reasoning-slider" `
  -Target "<克隆下来的目录>"
```

再在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 里把包加进依赖和 bundles 列表：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-reasoning-slider": "link:<克隆下来的目录>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "…", "dsh-reasoning-slider" ] } }
}
```

正在运行的 DSH 会监听 profile 组合并自动重载，浏览器刷新即可看到效果。

## 卸载

设置 → 插件 → 已安装 → 关掉 **dsh-reasoning-slider** 的开关（或删除它），刷新页面即回到官方样式。

手动安装的话，从 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉这一项，并删除
`node_modules\dsh-reasoning-slider` 链接。

## 工作原理

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` 用默认优先级 `0` 占用了单占位槽
`conversation.input.model`。`dsh-client-ui-slots` 对同名单槽的规则是
**「同优先级重复注册直接报错，换一个优先级即可遮蔽，优先级最低者渲染」**，
所以本插件用 `priority: -1` 注册自己的组件，渲染权落到本插件，而官方那份仍然被加载，
其服务与指令不受影响 —— 不需要 `disabled: true` 去覆盖官方设置页。

数据全部来自占位槽注入的 props（`available` / `directory` / `load` / `select`），与官方组件一致；
写回同样走 `select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`。

### 两个坑（写同类插件的人可以抄）

- **必须声明 `remote` + `remote.session`**：`directoryFor()` 内部会访问 `ctx.remote.session` /
  `ctx.sessions`，而 Cordis 是按 **调用方** 的 inject 声明做访问检查的。漏声明会在渲染时报
  `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`，并让该槽位条目直接崩溃。
- **浏览器半边不需要构建**：手写 CJS 包体即可，只要 `factory` 返回 `module.exports`：

  ```js
  window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '<包名>', factory: (require) => { /* … */ return module.exports; } });
  ```

  本插件只 `require` 平台基线模块（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`react-dom`、
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），因此 `dsh.client.external` 为空。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client.platform: web` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 自挂载行（`id` 必须等于包名） |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边（Web 端逻辑都在 client，这里只占位） |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：locale、样式、滑块、模型二级菜单、槽位注册 |

## 常见问题

**装完没变化？**
浏览器半边在页面加载时注入，刷新一次页面（`Ctrl+R`）即可。不用重启 DSH 服务。

**控制台报 `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`？**
inject 里补上 `remote` 和 `remote.session`，见上文「两个坑」。

**和别的插件抢同一个槽位？**
单占位槽同优先级重复注册会直接抛错，换个优先级（例如 `-1`）就能并存并遮蔽。

**档位和模型的组合对不上？**
档位来自当前模型自身的 `reasoning` 声明：不同模型的档位数量、名称、默认档都可能不同，
卡片上的档位名与说明文字都取该模型自己的定义。

## 开发

没有构建步骤：直接改 `lib/client.js`，刷新页面即可。改完后插件宿主会自动重载并更新资源版本号。

```bash
node --check lib/client.js   # 语法检查
node --check lib/index.js
```

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（profile 名 `tauri`，Web 端）上开发并验证。插件不声明 `peerDependencies`、
不声明 `dependencies`，因此不会与 profile 里已有的运行时冲突。

验证记录见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。

## English

`dsh-reasoning-slider` replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer's reasoning-effort picker with an
inline slider card: drag the thumb, click anywhere on the track, or use the arrow keys / `Home` /
`End`; the top-right button resets to the model's default effort. The model submenu (groups, search,
checkmarks) is kept in the same style. It shadows the shipped selector by registering into the
`conversation.input.model` single slot at `priority: -1`, so the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` plugin keeps working untouched. Install with
`dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider`, then refresh the page.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH native collaboration: main-agent architecture and validated plans, parallel workers, verification and independent review.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 协作开发插件

[English](README.en.md) · [下载 v1.0.0](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

主智能体规划，子智能体并行开发，验证与独立审查通过后汇总交付。

## 安装

适用于 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**，需要已配置的模型和 Node.js ≥22.19.0。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-collab-dev-1.0.0.tgz
```

网页版将 `desktop` 换成 `web`，安装后按宿主提示重启。本包已内置团队组件，同一 profile 请勿重复启用独立 AgentTeams bundle。

## 使用

```text
/collab-dev 为现有应用增加订单 API 和订单查询页面
```

1. 主智能体检查项目，建立共享框架、接口和完整任务计划。
2. 在团队面板审阅计划，点击 **Approve & Run**。
3. 两个 worker 并行开发，verifier 验证，reviewer 独立审查，最后集成。
4. 输入 `/collab-status` 查看进度、验证结果和交付阻塞。

计划和架构保存在 `.collab-dev/`。无效依赖、缺失验收阶段及并行写入范围冲突会被拒绝；上传不完整的计划无法批准运行。调整草稿任务数量时，请丢弃草稿并重新保存、创建计划。

## 范围

v1.0.0 使用 DSH 原生子智能体与共享工作区，按任务范围协作；不提供文件系统隔离、独立 worktree 或 Codex／Claude Code 后端。目前已验证 Windows、Node 24.15.0 和上述 DSH 版本。

[开发与测试](DEVELOPMENT.md) · [验证记录](VERIFICATION.json) · [计划示例](examples/plan.json)

MIT · [第三方来源与许可证](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
