plugins.description: Mark things on a picture and look at the picture: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns an image into a record of numbered marks, with coordinate-labelled close-ups and comparison sheets you can check.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-reasoner

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets a model put numbered marks on a picture and
look at what it drew. A place is named in the picture's own pixels, read off a
labelled grid, so nothing is converted from a preview and no call has to be
expressed in the terms of an earlier one. It is not specific to any kind of
picture: counting the people in a photograph is one use, checking which of two
similar regions a note meant is another.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `camera_reset` | Point the camera at the whole picture — one square window holding all of it, the picture drawn inside and the rest black — and see it. |
| `camera_move` | `step: "next"` walks the sweep in reading order, `"previous"` steps back, a direction steps one whole window, and `to: [x, y]` centres the window on a place read off the grid. |
| `camera_zoom_in` / `camera_zoom_out` | One ×2 or ÷2 step each, about the centre, `times` for several at once. The camera stays where it is left. |
| `mark_add` | Mark places by their coordinates, `at: [x, y]` in original pixels, with a radius `r`, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to the batch and the answer is a window around it. |
| `mark_remove` | Delete marks by number, e.g. `[3, 7]`, when a mark is in the wrong place. |
| `mark_edit` | Move, resize, recaption or recolour marks by number, in one call. |

Every picture comes back with a grid whose lines sit at round positions in the
picture's own pixels — 100, 200, 500, depending on how closely it is being looked
at — and every line is labelled with that number along all four edges. A number the
model reads is a number it can use. Every result also lists the whole record, with
the coordinates of every mark, so a mark placed twice, or in the wrong spot, is
visible in the next answer rather than several calls later. The tools never count
or judge what is in a picture: that is the model's statement to make.

The package also publishes a skill, `vision-sweep-count`: the workflow this tool set was
built around — see the whole picture, sweep it window by window, mark as you read, read the
window that comes back, count the record. A model reads a skill when a task matches one, which
matters here because pointing inside reasoning is a mode a model does not enter on its own.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-vision-reasoner
```

Or from the Web UI: **Plugins → Add plugin**, with the package name. The package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml` (one Host row), which the
profile loader applies the next time the profile loads. There is no build step and
no install script.

The only dependency is [`sharp`](https://sharp.pixelplumbing.com/) (Apache-2.0),
which the harness already uses for every image a session attaches
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` depends on it), so a deployment that can run
this plugin already has it. Nothing third-party is vendored: the icon and the two
locale files are this package's own. Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

## How it is used

1. **Look first.** A place is named from what has been seen, and the tool
   descriptions say so before anything else. The grid on the returned picture is
   the only ruler: the picture is not cropped with another tool, and no position is
   read off another view of it, whose pixels are a different size.
2. **Read the labels.** The lines are at round numbers of original pixels, so a
   position is read by naming the line before a feature and estimating the gap —
   about a quarter of a step is as fine as the eye goes, which is why the grid steps
   finer as the view gets closer.
3. **Mark the coordinates.** `mark_add` takes `at: [x, y]`, a radius `r` in the
   picture's own pixels, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to what was marked
   and the answer is a square window around those marks, with a cross at each centre
   and the record beside it.
4. **Sweep in windows you keep.** `camera_zoom_in` until a face is big enough to read,
   then walk the picture with `camera_move` and `step: "next"`: the windows tile the
   picture from its centre, "next" goes left to right and then down, and every result
   says how far the sweep has got and which windows are left. A place read in a window
   already used is comparable with the last one.
5. **Check, then correct.** The marks are drawn in every view, so what is left unmarked
   in the window in front of you is what you have not dealt with, and the record beside
   it shows a number twice or a ring on nothing. `mark_edit` moves a mark that is nearly
   right and `mark_remove` deletes one that is not — at once, since a change comes back
   as a window around what it touched and a wrong ring misleads every view after it.

## Behaviour

**The record is not written to disk.** Marks live in the session log. The harness
logs every tool call with its arguments and its result, and the record is a fold of
those events, rebuilt with the same pure functions the live call used. A call
carries everything the fold needs — a place is a pair of pixels, a radius is a number
of pixels, and the camera is a list of ways it was aimed — so a reopened session recovers the
same record, and nothing appears beside your picture.

**Each picture is written twice.** The model receives an image block through the
attachment service, the shape `read_image` sends, so the picture arrives with the
call that drew it. The Web UI's preview needs a file, because it decides how to
render a document from its extension and an attachment object has none; the PNG is
therefore also written to `<cwd>/.dsh-vision/<name>.png` and reported
workspace-relative in `images[].path`. That directory is the only thing this plugin
writes, and only when there is a picture to show.

**A missing picture is reported, not thrown.** No attachment service, or a model
that does not declare image input (the gate `read_image` applies), returns the text
plus a note instead of an image block; so does a failed write. Anything merely
unknown — an unresolvable route, an adapter error — attaches anyway, because
withholding a picture over a failed lookup costs more than it protects.

**Pictures are read through `ctx.fs`**, so the sandbox decides what may be read.

## The grid

- Lines sit at multiples of a round step — 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 … — chosen as
  the coarsest step whose labels are still about 100 view pixels apart. A wide view
  and a close view therefore both stay readable, and neither changes what a number
  means.
- Every label is an original-image coordinate, on all four edges, whatever the view
  is. Nothing is scaled, and nothing has to be converted.
- Lines are drawn 2 pixels wide at minimum and scale with the view, because a
  one-pixel line is gone by the time the attachment pipeline has re-encoded the
  picture.
- Every view is rendered at the same longest side, so looking at a rectangle is
  never coarser than looking at the whole picture.
- The camera is a place, not an action. A look shows what is in front of the lens, `zoom` and
  `move` aim it, `reset` points it back at the whole picture, and every result says where it is —
  so a caller reads "closer, a little left" rather than inventing rectangles, and looking again
  needs no arguments at all.
- Marks are drawn by default, so the picture carries the record; `marks: false` gives a clean
  canvas for counting a place again from scratch.
- Every result counts the windows the camera has **stopped in** since the last reset, names the
  one it is in, and names the ones still left: an unswept corner is a word in the answer rather
  than something a caller has to keep in its head.
- The window line says how the drawing relates to the picture — `drawn 1400x1400 (1.08x of the
  picture)` — because a caller that reads the rendering as the picture itself is wrong by exactly
  that ratio. One session reported reading a "1540x1084 preview" while every number it had was
  in a 2600-pixel space, and concluded the mapping was ambiguous.
- Every view is the same shape: a 1400x1400 square. The picture is placed inside it at the scale
  that fits and whatever is left over is black, so no view can come back as a strip one face

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

# dsh-lfaa

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A complete native DSH plugin project with independently owned business modules. Appearance, layout, cards, dialogs and motion are one capability group, not the definition of the whole plugin. This is a new project designed around DSH; it does not copy or migrate the old LFAA project.

DSH owns accounts, all AI execution, sessions, models, subagents, tool dispatch and approval. The plugin contributes its own business through public interfaces and keeps business data local when needed. No second harness, login or conversation store is introduced.

## Repository

```text
packages/
  dsh-lfaa/              Plugin composition and distribution manifest
  dsh-lfaa-workspace/    Left menu, main workspace, Session tab, right pane, Settings
  dsh-lfaa-appearance/   Appearance schema and reversible theme/motion projection
scripts/                 Build and repository checks
tests/                   Focused regression tests
docs/                    Architecture, extension contracts and validation
dist/                    Generated output only; ignored
```

Package directories and manifest names use the `dsh-` prefix. Private implementation packages are bundled into one installable `dsh-lfaa` artifact; users do not install the development workspace.

## Develop

```powershell
npm install --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
npm run check
```

The installable output is `dist/packages/dsh-lfaa/`. The build excludes private workspace dependencies, development source, test fixtures and user data. Install that output through DSH's official profile plugin command, not the repository root. The package is currently private and is not published by this workflow.

The current implementation contributes native workspace surfaces and the first interface-experience module. Other business capabilities are not defined or claimed. Read the [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [extension points](docs/extension-points.md), [development standard](DEVELOPMENT.md), [agent rules](AGENTS.md) and [actual validation](docs/validation.md).

# dsh-video-grab —— 让 Agent 真的"看"视频（免 ffmpeg）

> 给 DSH 用的 host 插件。核心不是"能抓帧"，而是**用得起**：一条 33 秒的视频，
> 逐帧读完约 61 万 token（爆），拼成一张联系表约 2200 token（一次读图看完整条）。

## 一、它解决的问题

Agent 看视频有个硬约束：**读一张图的成本 ≈ 宽×高÷750 token**。

| 做法 | 33 秒 / 720×720 / 883 帧 |
|---|---|
| 逐帧读原图 | 883 × 约 690 ≈ **61 万 token**（任何上下文都装不下） |
| 一张联系表（20 格） | 1440×1152 ≈ **2200 token，一次读完** |

所以「看完一条视频」的正确姿势是**联系表**，不是抽一堆帧再一张张读。

第二个约束：这台机器上**没有 ffmpeg，也没有 yt-dlp**。解法是借本机已有的
**Electron**（`electron.exe` 自带 `ffmpeg.dll`，即 Chromium 的解码器）：
插件拉起一个隐藏窗口播 `<video>`，seek 到采样点，`drawImage` 到 canvas，导出 PNG。

## 二、四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `video_probe` | 只读容器结构：轨道、编码、分辨率、样本数、时长（不解码，毫秒级） |
| `video_sheet` | **主力**：按时间点采样拼一张联系表，返回 PNG 绝对路径（用 `read_image` 读） |
| `video_frames` | 均匀抽 N 帧存 PNG（只在需要逐帧细看时用，token 贵） |
| `video_fetch_bilibili` | 匿名取 B 站**公开**视频直链并下载到本地（不需要账号/登录） |

典型流程：

```
video_fetch_bilibili { bvid: "BV1WLpA6uEB1" }   → 本地 mp4 路径
video_sheet          { path: "<上一步的路径>" }  → PNG 路径
read_image           { file_path: "<PNG 路径>" } → 真的看到内容
```

## 三、实测数据（2026-10-12，本机）

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `video_probe` 33 秒片 | 0.0s，`720x720 avc1 32.7s 883 样本`（音频轨 mp4a 1407 样本） |
| `video_sheet` 12 格 | 23.9s，成图 `1440x864`，2.1 MB |
| `video_sheet` 20 格 | 41s，成图 `1440x1152`，2.9 MB |
| `video_frames` 4 帧 | 8.8s |
| `video_fetch_bilibili` | 1.8s，下回 1571 KB |

耗时几乎全花在 seek 上：**格数越多越慢**（约 1.5-2s/格）。20 格 ≈ 40s 是常态。

## 四、⚠️ 六个实测过的坑（别"简化"掉）

1. **`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 会让 electron 变成纯 Node**：它是 DSH 宿主注入给子进程的，
   一旦存在，`electron.exe` 不建窗口、不跑应用代码、静默退出（exit=1，约 100ms）。
   本插件**显式构造子进程环境**（只保留 Electron 需要的键），这个变量根本不在里面。
   注意：Windows PowerShell 5.1 里 `Remove-Item Env:` 实测**清不掉**它。
2. **`"type": "module"` 会连累 Electron helper**：本包 host 侧是 ESM，所以 package.json 有
   `"type": "module"` —— 这个 type 会一并套到 helper 上。helper 必须叫 **`main.cjs`**，
   否则 `require('electron')` 抛 `ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope`，
   表现为"启动即退、没有任何输出"。
3. **带值开关会吃掉入口脚本**：`electron --disable-gpu main.cjs ...` 里，
   electron 把入口脚本当成了 `--disable-gpu` 的值（`--disable-gpu=main.cjs`），
   argv 整体位移。所以参数按**"第一个 `.cjs`/`.js` 之后的"**来取，不按位置取。
4. **`app.exit()` 可能抢在文件落盘前**：回执一律写文件（`_result.json`），退出前留 300ms。
5. **不要捕获子进程 stdio**：往被关闭的管道写日志会 EPIPE，Electron 把它升级成
   用户桌面上的模态错误框。插件的 `stdio` 固定 `'ignore'`，进度写 `<outDir>/_sheet.log`。
6. **MP4 里 VisualSampleEntry 的宽高偏移**：从 box 起点算 +32/+34（8 头 + 6 保留 + 2 dataRefIdx
   + 16 预定义 + 4 宽高）。写成 +24/+26 会**稳定读出 0x0**，且不报错 —— 实测踩过。

排查顺序建议：先看 `<outDir>/_sheet.log`（每步都有时间戳），再看 `_result.json`，
最后才怀疑环境。**"没有日志"本身就是结论**：说明进程没进到应用代码。

## 五、依赖与边界

- **零 npm 依赖**（只用 node: 内置模块 + 本机 `electron.exe`）。
- Electron 位置：`DSH_ELECTRON` / `VIDEO_GRAB_ELECTRON` 环境变量优先，
  否则找 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe`。
- **只支持 Chromium 能解的编码**（H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1…）。本机是精简版 Electron，
  **专有编码可能缺失**；遇到解不了的情况会如实报"没有可解码的画面"，不会假装成功。
- **音频听不到**：只处理画面。台词要靠视频自带的字幕/画面文字，或另行转写。
- **只能看定格**：联系表是N 张静态图，运动过程、节奏、音效都拿不到。
- B 站下载**只处理公开视频**，付费/仅登录可见会如实失败；文件名里的非法字符会被替换。

## 六、安装 / 卸载

```powershell
$dsh = "C:\Users\Elysia\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add    D:\workspace\workplace2\dsh-video-grab-0.1.0.tgz
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-video-grab
```

装完要**重启 / 开新会话**才会出现这四个工具（host 侧的 JS 是加载时进内存的）；
helper 的改动则立即生效（每次调用现读磁盘）。

## 七、许可与出处

- MIT。解码借用本机已安装的 Electron，不随包分发任何运行时。
- B 站接口按公开页面所见的调用方式使用，仅取公开视频、匿名访问；请自行遵守平台条款。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件：用 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）把 Codex、Claude Code 等外部 Agent 注册成模型提供方
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tauri-acp

DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件：用 ACP（[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com)）把外部 Agent（Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等）注册成 dsh 的模型提供方。在模型选择器里选中它，对话就会交给这个 Agent 处理。

## 工作方式

- 每个配置项是一个 provider 路由，插件按需拉起该 Agent 子进程（stdio JSON-RPC），进程常驻复用。
- 每个 dsh 会话对应一个 ACP 会话，后续轮次只发送新增的用户消息；历史对不上（切过模型、被压缩）时自动新建 ACP 会话，并把历史压平成 `<conversation_history>` 一次性带过去。Agent 收图时历史里的图片按原位置作为 `image` 块重发，不会被压成文本。
- 模型列表来自 Agent 的 `configOptions`（`category: "model"`），兼容旧版 `models` + `session/set_model`；`default` 表示用 Agent 自己的默认模型。
- 模型元数据来自 Agent 本身（需要时会先启动一次 Agent 探测，受 `discoverModels` 控制）：
  - **推理等级**：Agent 的 `thought_level` 选项映射成 dsh 的推理等级，模型选择器里出现「推理等级」菜单；选中的等级经 `session/set_config_option` 设置，Agent 会话初始的等级作为默认等级上报（选择器里打勾的那一项，不再额外出现 dsh 自己的 Default）；Agent 对当前模型不提供的等级会被忽略并记日志。
  - **图片输入**：输入类型按 ACP 协议问 Agent 本人——`initialize` 应答里的 `promptCapabilities`。dsh 解析元数据时若还没人跟这个路由握过手，插件会先做一次握手（只握手，不开会话、不发轮次）把能力问出来，答案按路由记在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tauri-acp/prompt-capabilities.json`（连同启动命令的指纹，换了命令即作废），重启后首轮直接可用。声明 `promptCapabilities.image` 且 dsh 挂了附件服务时模型声明为 文本+图片，图片按 dsh 的请求尺寸（与 pi-ai 默认相同：≤4MP、≤1MB）重新编码后作为 ACP `image` 块发送。能力未知时不作声（dsh 把缺省读作「未知」并原样下发图片），而不是谎报纯文本——显式报纯文本会让 dsh 在进入插件之前就把图片换成文本占位。`imageInput` 可覆盖 Agent 漏报的能力。
  - **上下文窗口**：优先用 `models[].contextWindow`，其次用 Agent 通过 `usage_update.size` 上报的大小（对话一轮后才知道，记在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tauri-acp/context-windows.json`，重启后首轮直接可用），再次是模型 id、名称或描述里的 `1m` 标记（如 `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`、`(1M context)`，按 1000000 算），最后是 `contextWindow` 配置。ACP 在一轮对话前不提供窗口大小，所以从没跑过的模型首轮仍按配置值算。
- `agent_message_chunk` 映射为正文，`agent_thought_chunk`、工具调用、计划映射为推理块；`usage` 按会话累计值做差分。
- 工作目录取当前 dsh 会话的 workspace，取不到时回退到 `cwd` 配置或用户主目录。
- Agent 的权限请求默认走 dsh 原生审批框（`ctx.approval`）。
- 标题生成、压缩等辅助调用使用一次性 ACP 会话，不影响主会话。

## 安装到桌面端

插件是标准的 dsh bundle 包（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`）。先构建：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp.git
cd deepseek-harness-acp
npm install && npm run build
```

然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 里加上依赖和 bundle，重启桌面端：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-tauri-acp": "link:/path/to/deepseek-harness-acp"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-tauri-acp"]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在档案目录执行一次安装来建立链接。要用和桌面端相同的 pnpm（看 `node_modules/.modules.yaml` 里的 `packageManager`，当前是 11.8.0，需要 Node ≥ 22.13），否则 pnpm 会要求清空整个 `node_modules`：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && npx -y pnpm@11.8.0 install --prefer-offline --config.minimum-release-age=0
```

link 模式下，插件会从本仓库的 `node_modules` 解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`，和宿主不是同一个实例。所以适配器的失败一律以带内 `finish` 返回，不依赖 `instanceof LlmError`。改完代码执行 `npm run build`，再重启桌面端即可生效。

也可以放进 dsh-desktop 仓库的 `packages/`，再加进 `dsh-tauri-bundle` 的依赖里随包内置。

## 设置页

插件带一个客户端设置页：设置 → **ACP Agents**（排在官方「模型」页之后），不用手写 YAML 就能添加、编辑、删除 Agent。

- 表单字段：路由名、显示名、启动命令、参数（每行一个）、环境变量（每行一个 `KEY=VALUE`）、认证方法、权限策略、图片输入、模型列表。表单不展示的字段（`cwd`、`systemPrompt`、超时等）保存时原样保留。
- **导入 JSON**：粘贴其他 ACP 客户端的配置一次导入多个 Agent，支持 Zed 的 `agent_servers`（也认 `agentServers`）、本插件自己的 `agents` 段，或直接的 `{ "名称": { "command", "args", "env" } }` 映射，其他键（如 `default_mcp_settings`）忽略。名称转成路由名（`CodeBuddy Code` → `codebuddy-code`，没有字母数字的名称用 `agent`，重名加 `-2`），原名作为显示名。先预览：每项标「新增」或「覆盖」，缺 `command`、`args` 不是字符串数组、`env` 不是字符串映射的条目列为跳过。每项前有复选框（默认全选，可一键全选/全不选），只导入勾选的。覆盖已有路由时只替换显示名、命令、参数和环境变量，权限、认证方法、模型等设置保留。勾选的条目一次原子写入。没带 `PATH` 的条目（如 `codebuddy`、`traecli`）用的是桌面端自己的 `PATH`，从 Dock 启动时可能找不到命令，必要时改成绝对路径或在 env 里补 `PATH`。
- **发现模型**：按已保存的命令启动 Agent，读取它公布的模型并追加到列表（已有的行不动）。发现请求只能带路由名、带不了命令行，所以新 Agent 要先保存；编辑中未保存的命令修改也不会参与发现。发现结果不受 `models`、`discoverModels` 影响，总是 Agent 自己公布的列表。
- 保存经 `ctx.configForms.get('dsh-tauri-acp')` 原子写入本插件条目的配置（带 revision 防覆盖），落到档案的 `cordis.patch.yml`。`agents` 字段声明为 `.volatile()`：DSH 0.2 的设置服务只把 volatile 字段做成可编辑表单（没有它设置页不会出现），并在原处提交修改、触发 `loader/volatile-update`，宿主据此重新注册路由，不重启插件，下一次请求即生效。改名会先删旧路由再写新路由。写入被拒（例如别处同时改过）时会重新读取并提示。
- 由 bundle 层声明的 Agent 带 `YAML` 标记：可以在设置页覆盖字段，但不能改名或删除。
- 设置页面向 DSH NEXT（0.2 核心）：设置段按档案条目 id 分段，即 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入的 `dsh-tauri-acp`；条目 id 改了的话设置页不会出现。宿主会关闭这个条目自动生成的通用表单，并把模型页的 provider 目录指向同一个段。0.1 核心（`settings.installSection`，段名 `llm-acp`）宿主仍可用，但没有这个设置页。
- 档案不可写时只读展示。

## 配置

除了设置页，也可以在档案的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖插件配置：

```yaml
- id: dsh-tauri-acp
  name: dsh-tauri-acp
  config:
    agents:
      codex:
        displayName: Codex (ACP)
        command: /Users/you/.nvm/versions/node/v22.12.0/bin/codex-acp
        authMethod: api-key
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: sk-...
      claude-code:
        displayName: Claude Code (ACP)
        command: /usr/local/bin/npx
        args: [-y, '@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp']
        permission: ask
```

设置页保存的也是这一段配置。0.1 核心上同样的结构也可以写进 dsh 用户设置的 `llm-acp` 段，修改后下一次请求即生效。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `displayName` | 路由名 | 模型选择器里显示的名字 |
| `command` / `args` | 必填 / `[]` | 启动 ACP Agent 的命令 |
| `env` | `{}` | 追加给子进程的环境变量（在继承的环境之上） |
| `cwd` | 会话 workspace | 子进程目录，以及取不到会话 workspace 时的 ACP 会话目录 |
| `authMethod` | 无 | 握手后调用 `authenticate` 的方法 id；出错信息会列出 Agent 支持的方法 |
| `models` | `[]` | 手动声明模型（`id`、`name`、`description`、`contextWindow`）；声明后不再自动发现 |
| `discoverModels` | `true` | 未声明模型时，启动 Agent 读取它公布的模型列表 |
| `permission` | `ask` | `ask` 走 dsh 审批框（无审批服务时降级为 `read-only`）；`allow` 全部允许；`read-only` 只允许 read/search/think/fetch；`reject` 全部拒绝 |
| `imageInput` | `auto` | `auto` 按 Agent 在 ACP 握手里公布的 `promptCapabilities.image` 判断；`force` 不管公布什么都开（Agent 漏报时用）；`off` 一律按文本占位。没挂附件服务时三者都是纯文本 |
| `systemPrompt` | `drop` | `forward` 会把 dsh 系统提示词包在 `<system_instructions>` 里发给 Agent。dsh 提示词描述的是 dsh 自己的工具，一般不建议转发 |
| `showToolCalls` | `true` | 把 Agent 的工具调用和计划显示在推理块里 |
| `contextWindow` | `200000` | 上报给 dsh 的上下文窗口（用于压缩策略）；Agent 通过 `usage_update` 报告过大小、或模型带 `1m` 标记时以那个值为准 |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 握手超时 |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 流式输出空闲超时，`0` 关闭 |

## 冒烟测试

```bash
npx tsx scripts/smoke.mts "$(command -v codex-acp)"
```

只做握手和模型发现，不消耗额度。末尾加 `-- 你的问题` 会真正发一轮对话（会走 Agent 的计费），`ACP_MODEL`、`ACP_AUTH_METHOD` 环境变量可指定模型和认证方式。

## 限制

- Agent 用的是它自己的工具，dsh 的工具（含 MCP）不会传给它；插件不会产出 `tool-call`，每轮由 Agent 自己跑完。
- 文件按文本占位发送（dsh 在进入任何适配器之前就把文件块换成了句柄文本，插件拿不到原始引用，所以 ACP 的 `resource`／`embeddedContext` 用不上）；Agent 不支持图片时图片也按文本占位。dsh 的内容块里没有音频，所以 ACP 的 `promptCapabilities.audio` 只做记录，没有可发的内容。
- 推理等级列表取自 Agent 最近一次会话（默认模型下）提供的等级，换模型后等级集合变化的话，以 Agent 实际接受的为准。
- 重试策略固定为不重试，避免 Agent 重复执行有副作用的操作。
- 从 Finder/Dock 启动的桌面端拿不到 shell 的 `PATH`，`command` 建议写绝对路径。
- 官方「模型」页里的 provider 编辑器是为 HTTP 接口设计的，ACP 路由请在「ACP Agents」页或 YAML 里配置；在模型页点开 ACP 路由的「编辑」时，官方编辑器里那行「其余字段在 cordis.patch.yml 中…(dsh-tauri-acp)」会被替换成指向「ACP Agents」页的提示。官方编辑器没有给插件留插槽，这是按 DOM 替换的：只改设置弹窗里以 `(dsh-tauri-acp)` 结尾的那一行，插件卸载时停止。

## 开发

```bash
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

`npm run build`（`tsdown.config.ts`）同时产出宿主入口 `dist/index.js`（ESM，Node）和客户端入口 `dist/client.cjs`：一个只向 DSH web 的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 注册工厂的 CJS 脚本，`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/*` 由宿主模块表提供，不打进包里。

- 客户端运行在 DSH 的 web 模块表里，只能 `require` 平台种子词（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/*`）和档案里作为条目加载的包。所以客户端只依赖 `react` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，设置读写、文案、槽位都走 `ctx.configForms` / `ctx.locale` / `ctx.slots` / `ctx.remote.llm` 服务；不能用 `dsh-tauri` / `dsh-tauri-ui`（DSH NEXT 档案里没有它们，会报 `require("dsh-tauri") missed the module table`）。构建后可以检查：`grep -o 'require(\`[^\`]*\`)' dist/client.cjs`。
- 样式自带（`src/client/styles/agents.ts`，挂成 `<style>`），只用宿主的 `--dsw-*` 设计变量：web 壳不给第三方 bundle 提供工具类 CSS。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 不安装（它的 cordis peer 范围和这里的 alpha 版冲突，运行时也由宿主提供），用到的部分在 `types/dsh-client-ui-primitives.d.ts` 里按 0.2.0-rc.2 的类型声明。
- 客户端测试覆盖设置段投影、表单校验、JSON 导入、写入操作和模型发现；`tests/client-section.test.tsx` 用 `react-dom/server` 渲染设置页，`tests/client-import-view.test.tsx` 在 happy-dom 里点选导入项（primitives 由 vitest 别名指向 `tests/stubs`），表单替身的方法依赖 `this`，和真实 `ConfigForm` 一样。

测试用 `tests/fixtures/mock-agent.mjs` 这个 mock ACP Agent 覆盖：模型发现与切换、增量会话复用、历史重建（含历史图片重发）、四种权限策略、取消、空响应、认证，推理等级、握手公布的输入能力（含落盘复用、换命令作废和 `imageInput` 覆盖）、上报的上下文窗口，以及在真实 cordis + `LlmRuntime` 下的注册、卸载和 volatile 配置热更新。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: System monitor overlay for DeepSeek Harness: a corner pill showing live CPU and memory, expanding into disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery. Windows collector.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-monitor

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A system monitor overlay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a compact pill in the bottom-right corner showing live CPU and memory, expanding into a detail card with disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery.

Runs on **Windows**.

![Collapsed and expanded states](https://unpkg.com/dsh-windows-monitor/docs/preview.png)

## Features

- **Never covers the middle.** Collapsed it is a ~210 px pill; expanded it is a 280 px card. It sits clear of the composer by default.
- **Draggable.** Drag the pill or the card header anywhere; the position is clamped to the viewport and remembered. A reset control returns it to the corner.
- **Live at a glance.** The status dot is colour-coded — green nominal, amber elevated, pulsing red for collection failure.
- **Detail on demand.** CPU, memory and **disk activity** as bars, plus one row per volume, a memory total, adapter state, uptime and battery.
- **Capacity and activity are never conflated.** The 磁盘 gauge is *busy time* — the same figure as Task Manager's own 磁盘 column, computed as `100 − PercentIdleTime`. Fullness is a separate per-volume row. A static "93% full" number sitting next to a live CPU reading reads as a stuck or broken dial, so it is never what the gauge shows.
- **Unknown is a real state.** Disk activity is best-effort: with no performance-counter provider, or before the first sample, the panel renders `--` rather than `0%`. A zero would be a claim about an idle disk that nothing actually measured.
- **Honest failure states.** A failed collection shows "unavailable" in the pill instead of stale numbers; a platform with no collector says so explicitly rather than looking broken.
- **Theme-native.** Every colour is a DSH theme token, so light and dark mode follow the app. Icons are inline SVG from the harness's own icon set — no icon fonts.
- **Accessible.** Real buttons with labels, visible focus rings, and animations disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the **Web** profile and the current profile-bundle system.
- **Windows.** The host process must be running on Windows; see [Platform support](#platform-support).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (to build from source).

No administrator rights are needed, and nothing is installed system-wide.

## Platform support

Windows only, and that is deliberate. The plugin is named for Windows, its headline reading (disk activity) comes from a Windows performance counter, and a collector the maintainer cannot run is a collector whose bugs they cannot reproduce. Shipping Linux and macOS collectors that were written from documentation — and that the author could never exercise on their own hardware — traded a promise the project could not keep for two code paths it could not maintain.

The host picks the collector from `process.platform`, never from the request.

| Platform | Collector |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | PowerShell + CIM/WMI (`Win32_Processor`, `Win32_OperatingSystem`, `Win32_LogicalDisk`, `Win32_Battery`, `Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfDisk_PhysicalDisk`) and `Get-NetAdapter`. Verified by the author on Windows 11 |
| **Anything else** | None. The route answers `501` with an explicit unsupported-platform body, and the panel renders that instead of empty gauges |

`linux` and `macOS` collectors did ship in `0.1.0`; they were removed in `0.2.0`. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).

CI still runs on all three runners, and that is also deliberate. `windows-latest` exercises the collector for real, while `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest` prove the negative contract: with no collector the plugin must answer the error rather than pretend. See [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).

Known limitations:

- Disk activity needs the Windows performance-counter provider. On a host where it is disabled or missing, the reading degrades to `--` instead of failing the snapshot.
- The collector pins the process culture to invariant. The fact format is `key=value` with `.` as the decimal separator, so a comma-decimal locale would otherwise emit unparseable numbers.
- Some drivers report `PercentDiskTime` several times above 100, which is why busy time is derived from the idle complement instead.

## Install

From npm — prebuilt, and the only path that needs no build permission:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-windows-monitor
```

From a local checkout — this is the path to use while developing:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-windows-monitor
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # confirm the windows-monitor row is composed
dsh --profile web
```

From a release tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-windows-monitor-<version>.tgz
```

From a pinned source tag — see [releases](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/releases) for the current one:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor#v0.2.1
```

A git install fetches source and runs this package's `prepare` build, which means package code executes on your machine outside the agent sandbox. pnpm refuses that until the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` explicitly allows it:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-windows-monitor: true
```

Read the source and pin a tag before granting that. A release tarball ships prebuilt files and needs no such permission.

## Configuration

This bundle inserts one Host/Client row, declared in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: windows-monitor
      name: dsh-windows-monitor
      inject: [shell, sandboxPolicy, webServer]
```

Override that row in your profile or home `cordis.patch.yml` to disable it or change its position in the tree.

Browser-local preferences are limited to one value: the dragged panel position, stored under the `dsh-windows-monitor:position` `localStorage` key. It is written only when you drag the panel and removed when you press reset. The plugin stores no metrics.

## How it works

The **Host half** registers one read-only route and runs the collector for its own platform through the harness `shell` service:

```
GET /api/windows-monitor/snapshot
```

The collector prints one `key=value` fact per line. A line format — rather than JSON — is deliberate: emitting correct JSON from PowerShell without assuming a JSON library is a portability trap, whereas `key=value` is trivial to produce and trivial to parse (and unit-test) on the TypeScript side. The host converts facts into the snapshot the client renders and stamps the timestamp itself.

The shell seam is driven through **both** of its entry points. DSH renamed `ctx.shell.run(spec)` to `ctx.shell.execute(spec)`, which resolves with a handle whose `result()` carries the outcome, so the host prefers `execute` and falls back to `run`. Hard-coding either one breaks the plugin on the harness versions that expose the other — `0.2.3` did exactly that and answered every poll with `ctx.shell.run is not a function`. `tests/collectors.test.ts` now covers both, plus a seam with neither.

Results are cached for 5 seconds, and concurrent polls share a single in-flight collection instead of racing, so the browser's polling never multiplies collector runs.

The **Client half** registers into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot. That layer is click-through by design — the panel opts into pointer events, so it never blocks the app underneath.

Neither half touches the model, the session, or the transcript. The plugin registers no tools.

## Security model

Read this before installing.

- **The collector is read-only.** It reads CIM/WMI and runs `Get-NetAdapter`. Nothing writes, installs, or changes machine state.
- **The sandbox grant is broad.** The Host half resolves the `danger-full-access` sandbox policy so the shell ca

plugins.description: Quick Notes: a Cordis plugin for ACRYL and DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# acryl-quick-notes

A Cordis plugin for ACRYL and DeepSeek Harness: a small notebook icon in the top bar opens a Quick Notes list. Each note is saved as its own `.txt` file in the plugin's data folder on the host, so Web and Desktop share the same notes.

- Host half: `index.js` (stores the notes behind authenticated RPC routes under `/api`).
- Client half: `client.js` (the top bar button and the notes list).
- Permissions: `fs.write` (its own plugin data only), `ui`.

## Needs

The app it is loaded into must provide these Cordis services (each comes from a plugin of that app; they are listed in `package.json` as `acryl.requires`, generated from the code):

- Host: `connection`, `dshHomePath`.
- Client: `connection`, `slots`.

ACRYL and stock DeepSeek Harness (Web and Desktop) provide all of them; since 0.3.0 it runs in both (0.2.x needed ACRYL: its RPC channel relied on a `webServer` declaration stock DSH does not make). In an app without one of the services it waits and stays inactive; it never guesses a folder.

## Install

- ACRYL: type `/plugin pull github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes` in a chat, or run `acryl plugin pull github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes`, or paste `github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes` into the Plugins page's "Add plugin" box. Each installs the latest release, checked by its sha512.
- Stock DeepSeek Harness: paste the `.tgz` URL of the latest release into the Plugins page's "Add plugin" box, or run `dsh plugin --profile web add <that URL>`.

## Discovery

This repository carries the GitHub topics `acryl-package`, `cordis-plugin` and `dsh-plugin`, and `package.json` carries the same keywords. Catalogs that index those topics list it without a submission step.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 模型探测插件：用已存凭据查询厂商实时模型目录，预览后经官方配置编辑器安全写回。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 模型探测 · 0.1.0

在「设置 → 模型探测」中用 Host 已存 API key 查询厂商模型列表，与当前模型列表比较，然后通过官方配置编辑器预览、确认并采用。**列出模型不等于账号具备推理权限；本插件不调用推理接口。**

已验证环境：Windows，DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`，Cordis `4.0.4`，pi-ai `0.87.1`；内嵌 Node `24.18.1` 和普通 Node `24.21.0`。其他 DSH 版本尚未验证。

## 为什么不是点一下“获取可用模型”

官方页面当前读取的是运行时模型服务目录，而不是每次重新访问厂商 `/models`。pi-ai 随包携带静态目录；账户能用的模型、厂商实时目录和这个快照并不等价。只刷新页面不会更新包内目录。本插件不替换官方「模型」页、不修改 DSH 核心，也不把缺失模型自动删除。

## v1 支持范围

| 类型 | 模型列表请求 | 能力与限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Google Generative AI | `{base}/models?pageSize=1000`，`x-goog-api-key` | 仅保留 `generateContent`；读取厂商上下文/输出上限，不凭模型名推测图片能力 |
| OpenAI completions / responses、兼容网关 | `{base}/models`，Bearer API key | 标准 `data[]`，以及兼容的 `models[]` / `models{ID:信息}`；未知形状拒绝解析 |
| Anthropic Messages | `{base}/v1/models?limit=1000`，`x-api-key` + `anthropic-version` | 列表解析；未提供的容量留空或按下述来源补全 |
| OpenRouter | `{base}/models` | 可直接查询；也可显式勾选匿名参数补全 |
| OpenAI Codex OAuth | **不查询** | v1 只显示本地登录记录状态并手填模型参数；未验证发现端点，不能声称一键同步或查询成功 |
| 其他协议 | 不猜测 | 手填；兼容代理可显式选择已支持协议与地址后再查询 |

只取一页；识别到 `nextPageToken` / `has_more` 会标记列表可能不完整。不会自动翻页。空列表、认证失败、超时、格式不兼容不是删除现有模型的理由。

参数逐字段优先级：**厂商响应 > 同 provider 精确 ID 的内置目录 > 用户开启的匿名 OpenRouter 精确 ID 估算 > 手填 > 省略**。界面标注来源；不做跨厂商模糊匹配。用户在手填表中主动修订的值按手填内容采用。

## 使用

1. 先在官方「模型」页配置凭据或登录。插件没有 API key / token 输入框。
2. 打开「设置 → 模型探测」。普通 API 路由可查询，Codex 只有状态及手填区。
3. 查询不写配置。对兼容代理改地址会先提示是否向该地址发送当前路由的凭据；仅本次查询生效，不保存地址。
4. 勾选模型，或「载入勾选结果并修订」。手填区默认载入当前声明，支持 ID、名称、上下文、输出上限和 text/image 输入模态。数值必须是正整数；未知时留空。
5. 点「预览写入」，检查新增、移除、完整前后模型字段和来源。**采用是整体替换该路由列表，不是自动追加；要保留的旧模型必须仍在列表内。**
6. 再点「确认写入 profile」并确认弹窗。预览五分钟有效，单次使用；换选择、改手填内容或配置版本变化后需重新预览。
7. 「恢复内置目录」删除显式 `models` 键，绝不写成空数组；「查看模型备份」可预览并确认恢复目标路由的旧模型字段。

Codex 状态只区分缺记录、结构不支持、记录过期、读取失败或本地记录看似有效。**看似有效不等于在线授权或推理权限有效**。过期/缺记录请到官方「模型 → OpenAI Codex」重新登录；插件不刷新、不修改、也不发送 OAuth access/refresh token 或 account ID。

## 配置与安全边界

- Host 唯一写入入口为官方 `configEditor.edit`，锁内再次核对 revision；不自行拼接 YAML，不旁路写 profile。
- 仅改 `llm-pi-ai` 目标 provider 的 `models` / `modelOverrides`。采用显式列表时会先在预览中提示清除不兼容的旧 overrides，并将其备份。默认模型、其他路由、地址、凭据引用不变。
- 备份在 profile 的 `.model-probe-backups` 目录，只保存目标路由的白名单模型字段，不复制整份 YAML 或凭据。全局保留最近五份合法备份；成功和失败写入都尝试轮换。磁盘清理失败会明确提示，可能暂时超过五份；无关/损坏文件不擅自删除。
- 备份创建失败则不调用官方编辑器。备份含无法安全、无损保存的额外字段时拒绝写入，而不是静默截断。
- API key 仅在 Host 读取并发给用户确认的目标服务；禁用重定向，错误不回显响应正文、请求头或底层异常。已知本次 key 若被厂商回显到可展示字段则拒绝返回；这不构成任意编码/任意第三方敏感内容的 DLP 保证。
- 默认只允许 HTTPS；HTTP 仅允许 `localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]`。地址禁止用户名、密码、查询参数和 fragment。用户仍须自行确认 HTTPS 自定义服务可信；不是全面的网络隔离/SSRF 沙箱。
- 默认 20 秒超时；响应及单份备份最大 4 MiB；列表最多 10000 项；支持取消和卸载释放。不自动刷新、不后台轮询。
- OpenRouter 参数补全默认关闭；开启后发独立匿名请求，不携带当前厂商 key，不上传模型列表或提示词；只在 Host 用精确 ID 对照，失败保留原厂商结果。
- Client/Host 协议版本不一致及 404/405 有完整重启提示。配置保存与热更新验证分别报告；保存成功后核对失败不会谎报“未保存”。

## 安装与升级

**必须先得到用户对当前 profile 安装/启用的明确确认。** 两条路：

- **npm（普通用户）**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，填包名 `dsh-live-model-probe`（或 `dsh-live-model-probe@0.1.0` 锁定版本）。包名是 `dsh-live-model-probe`；仓库仍叫 [`lyufeng000/dsh-model-probe`](https://github.com/lyufeng000/dsh-model-probe)，npm 上原有的 `dsh-model-probe` 是别的作者的另一个插件，**不要**用这个名字。
- **本地源码（开发）**：源码根目录作为 `link:<绝对源码目录>` 依赖登记。

### 本地源码安装（开发用）

- bundle 为 `dsh-live-model-probe`，通过包内 patch 挂载 `model-probe`，Host 条目 ID 为 `include:model-probe`。不要再在 profile patch 中重复 insert。
- 安装前备份相关 profile 文件；通过官方插件管理器处理本地 bundle，检查依赖/锁文件仅作增量改动，不运行未经同意的构建脚本。
- 同步插件治理账本、校验 JSON/YAML；本插件源码不放到治理目录或 DSH 安装目录中。
- 安装/Host 更新后由用户**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**，不只是刷新页面。代理不得自停当前宿主。模型配置正常保存并验证热更新成功时则不需要重启。
- 本地 `link:` 依赖改源码即生效（Host 仍需完全重启）；npm 来源则要换版本重装。官方插件管理器目前**没有自动更新**，升级需卸载后重新安装。

## 测试复现（PowerShell，源码根目录）

普通 Node 单元测试（五项 DSH 集成测试在缺少 runtime 变量时跳过）：

```powershell
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT = '<临时工作目录>'
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

真实 DSH 集成测试，用实际安装路径替换以下变量。`DSH_MODEL_TEST_READ_PROFILE` **只读**，测试创建独立 Include/临时 profile，不写这个 profile。

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_RUNTIME = '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT = '<临时工作目录>'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_READ_PROFILE = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
& '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' --expose-internals --test --test-isolation=none test/*.test.mjs
```

真实浏览器测试复用这些变量，另可用 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_BROWSER` 指定 Chrome 可执行文件；默认 Windows Chrome 安装位置。测试开独立临时 profile 和 port 0 HTTP 服务，使用合成厂商响应，不使用真实 OAuth/API key；运行完释放临时 Host/浏览器，不替换当前 GUI。

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' --expose-internals scripts/browser-smoke.mjs
```

测试需要 Electron ASAR 环境和 Chrome；普通 Node 不能代替 ASAR 集成运行器。临时输出在 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT`，截图/结果位置打印到日志；可复现的入口是 `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs`（历史验收脚本未随本仓库发布）。

## 验收证据与尚未验证

本轮开发的 P0–P5 验收报告、界面截图与测试/冒烟输出保存在作者本地，**未随本仓库发布**；下面列出仍然成立与尚未验证的边界。

未验证：所有厂商的真实账号、模型推理权限、Codex 在线模型发现、真实 ACL 拒绝写入、断电/磁盘满、真实原子替换失败后的系统恢复。备份目录不可用已用“同名普通文件”故障注入验证，不冒充 ACL 测试；官方 schema/overlay 拒绝和真实热更新另有集成证据。不能把隔离测试通过称为用户当前桌面已安装验收。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH 待办清单插件（划词加待办 / 对话自动捕获 / 侧边栏面板 / 到期提醒）· DSH todo checklist plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-todo-checklist ·「待办清单」

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的待办插件：**把对话里冒出来的待办沉淀下来**。

[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-blue)](#环境要求) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.3.0-green)](#功能) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow)](#许可)

> Todo sidecar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: capture todos straight from the conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, and get due reminders via in-app popup or IM bot push. Data persists across restarts.

---

## 它能帮你做什么

- **划词加待办** —— 选中对话里的一句话，点「＋ 待办」，一句话变成一条待办
- **AI 记录待办** —— 把划词内容交给模型，自动拆成 标题 / 内容 / 提醒时间
- **对话自动记录** —— 说「记一下……」，模型调用内置工具 `todo_add` 写入
- **侧栏汇总** —— 左侧面板统一查看、搜索、筛选、勾选、分组
- **到期提醒** —— 到点弹**应用内提醒**，或推送到你的 **DSH-IM 机器人**
- **数据不丢** —— 重启 DSH 数据还在；单条数据损坏只影响该条，不影响整体

---

## 快速上手（3 步）

1. **安装**：左侧栏 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填 `dsh-todo-checklist` → **完全退出并重启 DSH**
2. **加一条**：在任意对话里选中一句话 → 点「＋ 待办」→ 选「🤖 AI 记录待办」或手动填写
3. **看与处理**：点左侧图标列底部的「待办清单」展开；勾选完成、双击跳回原句、到期自动提醒

---

## 截图

### ① 划词气泡 —— 选中一句话，点「＋ 待办」

在任意对话里选中文字，出现「＋ 待办」气泡：

![划词气泡](docs/screenshots/bubble.png)

### ② 记录弹窗 —— 手动填写，或交给 AI 整理

点气泡打开记录弹窗：可手动填写标题 / 内容 / 提醒时间，也可点「🤖 AI 记录待办」把这段话交给模型自动整理（含分段式提醒时间输入，点哪段 ± 就加哪段）：

![记录弹窗](docs/screenshots/popup.png)

### ③ 左侧面板 —— 汇总、搜索、勾选、跳回原句

待办收纳在左侧图标列底部「待办清单」，展开即可查看与处理：

![左侧面板](docs/screenshots/sidebar.png)

---

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 划词加入待办 | 对话里选中文字 → 出现「＋ 待办」气泡 → 弹窗：**🤖 AI 记录待办**（把这段话交给模型整理成标题 / 内容 / 提醒时间，整理中面板显示「⏳ AI 整理中」）或手动填写 |
| 对话自动记录 | 对话里说「记一下……」模型可调用内置工具 `todo_add` 写入；`todo_list` 用于查询现有待办 |
| 左侧栏面板 | 挂在官方左侧图标列底部：收纳态显示「待办清单 · 预期 N 项 · 待完成 N 项」，展开为列表；含搜索、全部提醒筛选、未完成 / 已完成 / 已放弃 / 逾期 分组 |
| 到期提醒 | 每 30 秒扫描：到点弹**应用内提醒**（可「知道了 / 查看 / 完成」，查看会跳回划词所在会话并高亮原句），或经 **DSH-IM 机器人推送**（可全局设置，也可单条待办覆盖机器人 / 目标） |
| 待办处理 | 勾选完成；双击标题或点 ↗ 新建会话（自动带上来源会话的工作区与模型，发送后该待办自动完成）；行内图标：编辑 / 转 AI 总结 / 删除 |
| 编辑与延期 | 编辑标题、内容、提醒时间（**分段式输入：年 / 月 / 日 / 时 / 分，点哪段 ± 就加哪段**，分 ±30 分钟、时 ±1、日 ±1、月 ±1、年 ±1，自动进位）；延期三档：+1 天、下周一 09:00、自定义 |
| 转 AI 总结 | 把已有待办交给模型重新整理成结构化内容，并替换原条目 |
| 转定时任务 | 把待办转成周期性定时任务（**需已安装「定时任务」dsh-tasks 插件**，未安装时会给明确提示） |
| 持久保存 | 个人存储域 `dsh_todo_sidecar_items`，重启 DSH 不丢；单条数据损坏只影响该条，不会让整个插件不可用 |

---

## 环境要求

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`（已测 `0.2.0-rc.1`、`0.2.0-rc.2`）
- Node.js `>= 22.18.0`
- 桌面端或 Web 端均可（客户端面声明 `platform: web`）
- **零运行时依赖**：宿主面已打包成自包含文件（`lib/host.js`、`lib/typert.js`，zod 已内联），安装时不需要下载任何依赖，离线 / 本地目录 / npm / tarball 四种装法都一致可用。

---

## 安装

**方式一：插件管理器（推荐）**
DSH 左侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件** → 填入 `dsh-todo-checklist` → 安装完成后**完全退出并重启 DSH**。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-todo-checklist
```

**方式三：本地目录 / tarball**（未发布或内网环境）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本地目录或 tgz 的绝对路径>
```

升级到最新版：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-todo-checklist@latest
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-todo-checklist
```

> 客户端界面部分的改动需要**重启 DSH** 才会生效。

安装成功的标志：打开任意会话，左侧图标列底部出现「待办清单」。

---

## 使用

- **加待办**：选中对话文字 → 点「＋ 待办」→ 选「🤖 AI 记录待办」让模型整理，或手动填标题 / 内容 / 提醒时间。
- **设提醒时间**：单次模式下，**点「年 / 月 / 日 / 时 / 分」任一段，再点 − / ＋ 按钮**，就在该段上步进（分 ±30、其余 ±1）；键盘 ↑ / ↓ 同样步进，← / → 切换段。
- **看与改**：点左侧「待办清单」展开；勾选完成；行内 ✎ 编辑、✦ 转 AI 总结、✕ 删除；⋯ 菜单为编辑 / 删除。
- **到点提醒**：默认弹应用内提醒；要在设置页勾选「DSH-IM 推送」后才会同时推送到机器人（需先装 dsh-im 并配置好机器人）。
- **新建会话**：双击待办标题，或点行内 ↗，会新建一个会话并把待办内容预填进输入框；新会话沿用**划词时那个会话的工作区与模型**，发送后该待办自动标记完成。

---

## 数据、隐私与权限

- **数据位置**：`<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh_todo_sidecar_items.json`（默认 `<DSH_HOME>` 为 `~/.dsh`）。卸载插件不会删除该文件，需要清空可手动删除。
- **网络**：插件自身不发起任何外部网络请求；只有在你启用「DSH-IM 推送」时，才会通过本机 DSH-IM 服务把提醒发给你已配置的机器人。
- **日志**：默认不写任何日志文件。排障时设环境变量 `DSH_TODO_DEBUG=1`，日志写入 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-todo/diag.jsonl`（可用 `DSH_TODO_STATE_DIR` 改目录）。
- **能力使用**：会话事件只读（用于到期提醒与自动完成）、按需创建会话（AI 记录 / 新建会话）、读取工作区列表、调用模型（AI 记录与 AI 总结）、调用 DSH-IM 发消息。

---

## 已知限制

- **提醒依赖 DSH 正在运行**：插件没有后台常驻进程，DSH 退出期间到点的提醒会在下次启动后补发。
- **机器人推送依赖 dsh-im**：未安装或未配置机器人时，推送不可用（应用内弹窗不受影响）。
- **转定时任务依赖 dsh-tasks**：未安装时无法转换，会给出提示。
- **AI 记录 / AI 总结会产生一次模型调用**（按你当前配置的模型计费）。
- 多个 DSH 实例同时运行时，同一条待办的机器人推送只会发出一次（跨进程原子认领）。

---

## 故障排查

- 打开 **F12 → Console**：
  - `__DSH_TODO_FOLLOWUP_TRACE__` —— 最近一次「新建会话」链路的逐步打点（工作区解析、RPC、打开会话）。
  - `__DSH_TODO_ENTRY_ERROR__` —— 界面槽位渲染异常记录。
- 提示「存储不可用」=待办数据文件无法解析，检查 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh_todo_sidecar_items.json` 是否为合法 JSON。
- 提示「插件刚更新过：请重启 DSH 桌面端后重试」=宿主与界面的方法清单不一致，重启即可。
- 修改了「在左侧边栏显示待办清单」开关后，需要重启 DSH 生效。

---

## 开发

```
dsh-todo-checklist/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle / dsh.client / dshhub 展示信息 / compatibility
├── cordis.patch.yml      # profile 配置层：插入 todo-sidecar 宿主插件
├── typert.js             # 宿主面 Typert 清单源码（strict codec，loader 自动发现）
├── host/
│   ├── index.js          # todos 服务、AI 记录、提醒引擎、todo_add / todo_list 工具
│   └── store.js          # 存储域与容错解析
├── client-src/index.js   # 客户端可读源码（手写 h()，无 JSX）
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-client.mjs  # esbuild → lib/client.js 工厂包
│   ├── build-host.mjs    # esbuild → lib/host.js、lib/typert.js（内联 zod，零依赖）
│   └── release-pack.mjs  # 打发布包：换名 + 重建产物 + 自检
└── lib/
    ├── client.js         # window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory }) 产物
    ├── host.js           # 宿主面入口（package.json 的 main）
    └── typert.js         # Typert 清单产物（exports["./typert"]）
```

- 构建全部产物：`node scripts/build-host.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs`（也可 `npm run build`）；模块 id 恒等于包名，与官方插件一致。
- 宿主面改动后必须重新 `build-host.mjs`——运行时读的是 `lib/host.js`，不是 `host/index.js`。
- `dependencies` 故意留空（zod 只在构建期需要，放在 `devDependencies`）：这样 `link:` 安装、离线安装都不会因为缺依赖导致插件激活失败。
- 打发布包（换名 + 重建产物 + 自检）：`node scripts/release-pack.mjs --name <npm包名>`。
- 变更记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

---

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: pick separate models and reasoning efforts for the main session, subagents, and plan mode.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-model-dispatch

English | [简体中文](README_CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Platform: Web](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Web-orange.svg)]()
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-69%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](tests)

**Give the main model, your subagents, and plan mode their own model and reasoning effort — from the chat bar, in one menu.**

![The model menu above the composer: model rows, the reasoning-effort slider, and the two composer chips](docs/images/menu-light.png)

DeepSeek Harness ships a model picker for the **main** model. This plugin keeps that control and adds the two routes it does not cover — the model that **delegated subagents** run on, and the model **plan mode** thinks with — then puts all three in one menu that behaves like a native control.

| Route | Set it from | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| **Main model** | chat-bar main chip · settings row 1 | the current session, through the native DSH switching API |
| **Subagent model** | chat-bar subagent chip · settings row 2 | subagents started *later* in this session |
| **Planning model** | settings row 3 | plan mode only; the pre-plan main model is restored afterwards |

---

## Table of contents

- [Features](#features)
- [Install](#install)
- [Usage](#usage)
  - [Chat bar](#chat-bar)
  - [Settings](#settings)
  - [Plan mode](#plan-mode)
  - [Subagents](#subagents)
- [Routing rules](#routing-rules)
- [Persistence](#persistence)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [Development](#development)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Credits](#credits)
- [License](#license)

## Features

- **Two composer chips, wearing the host's own material.** The input bar carries a main chip (the host's model glyph) and a subagent chip (a branch glyph); the icon alone tells them apart, while the tooltip and accessible name keep the full `Main · model · effort` label. Both are borderless 28px chips that only show a surface on hover, exactly like the neighbouring native controls. While the subagent route inherits, its chip reads **Follows main** instead of repeating the main model name.

  ![The two composer chips](docs/images/composer-light.png)

- **One menu for every route.** Search across models and providers, provider groups, favorites, recents, and reasoning effort — the same menu is used by the chat bar and the settings rows. It is built from the host menu's material (translucent blurred card, elevation shadow, 4px padding, 34px rows, 13px type, l2 hairlines), so it reads as a first-party control rather than a plugin overlay.

- **Reasoning effort as a discrete slider.** One stop per level, plus a leading **provider default** stop so "don't specify an effort" is a visible state instead of hidden behaviour. The scale is drawn under the rail (so it never seams the filled run), the current level is named in the header row, and the control is draggable and keyboard-operable.

  ![The reasoning-effort slider](docs/images/effort-light.png)

- **Live apply — no confirm row.** A model pick, a slider move, or a restore writes through immediately. A slider drag coalesces into a single write when it settles, writes are serialized, and a failed write rolls the row back and shows the real error. The menu stays open, so picking a model can be followed straight by an effort change; `Esc` or a click outside only closes the menu and never undoes a live choice.

- **Plan-mode auto switching.** Entering plan mode switches to the planning model; approving the plan or `/plan off` restores the pre-plan main model *and* effort before the first execution request. The review panel shows which model will be restored.

- **Per-session subagent overrides.** A chat-bar subagent pick is stored as a durable override for that session and never touches the settings default; one click restores the settings default.

- **Every catalog model is delegatable.** Subagent routing reads the host's live model catalog, so an explicit child selection and `list_subagent_models` keep working in existing sessions even when rc.2 captured an older allowlist. Models added later are available on the next delegation; removed routes and unsupported efforts are rejected up front.

- **Route validation before saving.** Overrides and child creation validate the exact provider/model/effort through the host's `resolveCallConfig`; an invalid combination fails immediately with the real reason instead of failing inside a run.

## Install

Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2** (other 0.2.x versions need a compatibility check — see [Compatibility](#compatibility)).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git@github.com:kolawong/dsh-plugin-model-dispatch.git
```

Replace `web` with the profile you actually use (`desktop`, …). Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**: the host half needs a recomposition, and refreshing the page only reloads the client half.

`lib/` in this repository holds the prebuilt host and client bundles, so installing needs no local build step.

<details>
<summary>Manual install (link a local checkout)</summary>

```jsonc
// <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-plugin-model-dispatch": "link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-model-dispatch" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "dsh-plugin-model-dispatch"] } }
}
```

Create the matching `node_modules` link (the profile directory is the resolution anchor), then restart DSH.
</details>

## Usage

### Chat bar

Two chips sit at the right of the composer, next to the permission and preset controls:

| Chip | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Main** (model glyph) | Switches the current session's model through the native API. The chip shows the effective route and its effort in the tooltip. |
| **Subagent** (branch glyph) | Picks the model for subagents started later in this session, stored as a session override. Reads **Follows main** while nothing is overridden. |

Opening either chip gives the same menu: search, provider groups, favorites (★, hover-revealed, remembered per browser), recents, the effort slider, and — for the subagent route — a **restore to settings default** row.

![The same menu in dark mode](docs/images/menu-dark.png)

### Settings

**Web settings → 模型切换 / Model switch** holds three rows, each with a one-line scope hint:

| Row | Meaning |
|---|---|
| New-session default model | Written to the native `agent-default-model` entry. Changing the model inside a chat does **not** change it. |
| Subagent default model | Used by subagents of any session that has no override. |
| Planning model | Used while plan mode is active. |

### Plan mode

1. Entering plan mode saves the session's current `provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort` atomically and switches to the planning model.
2. Approving the plan (or `/plan off`) restores that saved route **before the first execution request is assembled**.
3. If a restore fails it is retryable and never strands the session on the planning model; the approval panel names the model that will come back.

### Subagents

- A delegation started with explicit model options keeps them — the plugin only fills in a route where the native call left it open.
- The subagent chip and the settings default apply to **newly started** subagents; running ones keep their model.
- Subagent sessions themselves do not participate in plan switching or subagent overrides.

## Routing rules

| Decision | Precedence (highest first) |
|---|---|
| Subagent model | session override → settings default → native parent-model inheritance → explicit start options in the tool call |
| Plan model | planning model while plan mode is active → restored session route afterwards |
| Main model | session selection (native API) → new-session default from settings |

Defaults and sessions stay independent: the settings rows store new-session defaults, while chat picks and plan switches only affect the current session. The host adapter isolates the native `selectModel` "save as deployment default" side ef

plugins.description: PhotoCraft image editing and native desktop automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Windows, Intel Mac and Apple Silicon).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-photocraft

让 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）通过 MCP 使用 **PhotoCraft**：编辑图片、管理图层、调色、添加文字与形状、运行滤镜、保存工程、导出图片，以及操作原生桌面画布和截图。

独立社区集成，非 PhotoCraft 或 DeepSeek 官方插件。不包含编辑器二进制，不包含生成式 AI 模型。

## 支持范围

| 项目 | 本版范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Windows x64；macOS Intel / Apple Silicon，带可用的桌面会话 |
| DSH | 实测 `0.2.0-rc.2`，声明兼容 `^0.2.0-rc.2` |
| PowerShell | **PowerShell 7**，`pwsh` 可在终端运行；不是 Windows PowerShell 5.1 |
| PhotoCraft | 官方 **0.7.0** Windows 便携版 / macOS Universal 应用及 CLI，固定版本和 SHA-256 |
| 桌面渲染 | 默认 `--safe-gpu`，CPU 安全模式 |

Linux、Windows ARM64 和无桌面会话的服务器不在本版支持范围。PhotoCraft 当前源码的 0.8.0 功能不在本版验证范围内。

## 安装

先确认 `dsh --version` 和 `pwsh --version` 能运行。以下命令均在 **PowerShell 7** 中执行。安装方式使用 DSH 官方的 `dsh.bundle` 包机制，与其他 `dsh plugin add` 插件一致。

### 1. 安装插件包

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft#v0.2.0
```

### 2. 安装原生 PhotoCraft 运行时

```powershell
$dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile')) '.dsh' }
& "$dshRoot/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-photocraft/scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1"
```

Windows 安装器从 PhotoCraft 官方 GitHub 下载约 77 MB 的便携包，校验固定 SHA-256，再安装到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-photocraft`。macOS 下载 Universal DMG 和 CLI ZIP（共约 150 MB），校验两个 SHA-256，并验证应用与 CLI 代码签名，安装到 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft`。不需要 Rust、不需要管理员权限，不修改系统 PATH，也不使用 npm 的安装钩子执行下载。安装器会保留已有图片、工程和状态；重复运行会核对运行时文件校验值。

安装完成后重启 dsh，并创建新会话。使用其他 profile 时，将命令里的 `web` 换成相应名称。多个 profile 可以共用一次运行时安装。

**已使用旧版手工配置的用户：** 安装此包前，删除旧配置中 `mcp-photocraft` 与 `mcp-photocraft-ui` 两个条目，保留其他条目，避免重复注册。不需要手工配置的新用户可忽略此项。

### 从源码安装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft.git
cd dsh-photocraft
./scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

官方安装方式参考：[DSH 插件打包与安装](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。

### macOS 安装（系统终端 zsh / bash）

先安装 PowerShell 7（已安装可跳过；Homebrew 需自行安装）：

```sh
brew install --cask powershell
```

确认 `dsh --version` 和 `pwsh --version` 可运行，然后：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft#v0.2.0
pwsh -NoProfile -File "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-photocraft/scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1"
```

安装器按系统自动选择原生程序，Intel 和 Apple Silicon 使用同一个官方 Universal 包。不会清除 macOS quarantine 属性或绕过 Gatekeeper；如系统阻止启动，请先检查官方应用的签名与系统提示。完成后重启 dsh。通过 Finder 的“前往文件夹”打开 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft/workspace` 放入图片。

### 从 0.1.0 升级

再次执行安装插件命令（使用 `#v0.2.0`），然后重新运行安装脚本，更新启动器和平台脚本。运行时版本不变，已有图片和工程不会删除。关闭旧 PhotoCraft 窗口再重启 dsh，确保使用新启动器。

## 使用

把待处理图片放进 Windows 的 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-photocraft\workspace`，或 macOS 的 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft/workspace`。插件中的相对路径从该目录开始，输出也保存在这里。

对 dsh 说：

> 使用 PhotoCraft 创建一张 1200×800 的宣传图，背景深蓝，白色标题“周末摄影展”，加入黄色圆形装饰。生成预览，保存 poster.pcraft 和 poster.png。先通过 command_list 确认命令及参数。

或者：

> 用 PhotoCraft 打开 workspace 中的 input.jpg，提高亮度和对比度，缩放到宽度 1600 像素，保持比例，导出 output.jpg，不覆盖原图。

| 工具前缀 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp__photocraft__*` | 无界面编辑、保存、批处理、预览、切换和关闭文档 |
| `mcp__photocraft_ui__*` | 桌面编辑、界面检查、画笔鼠标事件、菜单、截图 |

两个后端拥有**独立文档会话**。要交换文档，先保存，再在另一端打开。桌面入口自动启动本机 PhotoCraft，不会将编辑界面嵌入 dsh 网页。多个客户端共享桌面窗口，请避免同时修改同一文档。断开 MCP 不会关闭桌面，防止丢失未保存的工作。

上游 MCP 在两个模式下都会列出全部工具，但 `ui_*` 和 `control_call` 只能用桌面入口；`doc_select` 和 `doc_close` 只能用无界面入口。桌面标签页操作走 `control_call`。

## 验证

**v0.2.0 跨平台实测（2026-10-12）：** [同一次 GitHub Actions 运行](https://github.com/DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft/actions/runs/38253618887)中，Windows x64、macOS 15 Intel、macOS 15 Apple Silicon 均通过完整的 **105 项检查 / 21 个 MCP 工具**，包括桌面启动、画布绘制和截图；两个 Mac 的截图已人工查看。其他 macOS 版本尚未逐一验证。

运行完整集成检查（会创建合成测试图片并打开一个桌面测试文档）：

```powershell
$install = if ($env:PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME) { $env:PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME } elseif ($IsWindows) { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'dsh-photocraft' } else { Join-Path $env:HOME 'Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft' }
& "$install/scripts/Test-PhotoCraftMcp.ps1" -InstallDir $install
```

初始本机验证：**21 个 MCP 工具、105 项检查通过，发现 858 条引擎命令**。覆盖图层、填充、调色、模糊、文字、形状、撤销/重做、批量命令、PNG 预览、原生工程、8 种格式导出重开（PNG/JPEG/WebP/TIFF/PSD/PSB/OpenRaster/OpenEXR）、RGB/Gray/CMYK/Lab 的 8/16/32 位保存、后台任务接口、桌面绘制和截图、资源读取、错误命令和越界路径拒绝。实际 dsh 模型会话也已完成新建、填色、保存和桌面状态读取。

报告保存到安装目录的 `validation.json`，预览在 `workspace/headless-preview.png` 和 `workspace/desktop-preview.png`。仓库 CI 在 Windows、Intel macOS 和 Apple Silicon macOS 上执行安装、重复安装和完整 MCP/桌面检查；具体通过情况见 GitHub Actions，不以平台分支存在代替实测。

这不是 858 条命令的穷举测试，也不保证复杂 PSD 与 Photoshop 完全一致。生成式填充、AI 扩图等 PhotoCraft 尚未实现的功能不会由本插件补齐。

## 配置与排错

以下环境变量需要在启动 dsh **之前**设置：

| 变量 | 默认值 / 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME` | Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%/dsh-photocraft`；Mac：`~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft`；安装器和插件必须使用同一路径 |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PWSH` | `pwsh`；可指定 PowerShell 7 可执行文件绝对路径 |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PORT` | `17878`；桌面本机控制端口 |

读写权限限定在安装目录的 `workspace` 下。令牌和日志保存在 `state`，不会提交到 GitHub。自定义安装位置时，设置 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME` 后再运行安装器，并让启动 dsh 的终端使用同一变量。

- 找不到运行时：先完成安装第 2 步；检查上述变量。
- 找不到 `pwsh`：安装 PowerShell 7，重新打开终端；或设置 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PWSH`。
- 端口被占用：关闭旧 PhotoCraft 桥接进程，或设置另一个 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PORT`。测试脚本另提供 `-Port` 参数。
- 桌面启动失败：查看 `state/app.stderr.log`。本版已使用安全渲染模式，但仍需要可用的桌面会话。
- Mac 首次启动可能出现“Switched to CPU rendering”提示，选择 **Keep Using CPU** 即可继续。两个 Mac CI 的截图中均出现此提示，编辑、保存与截图调用仍通过；本版不声称验证 GPU 加速。
- 路径拒绝：将图片放入 `workspace`；不要使用 `..` 越界访问。
- 安装包校验失败：不要跳过校验；删除下载缓存里的损坏 ZIP 后重新下载。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-photocraft
```

重启 dsh，正常关闭 PhotoCraft。运行时和工作图片会保留；确认不再需要后可手工移除安装目录。插件不会自动删除用户图片。

## 开发与授权

```powershell
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

包由 YAML 配置和 PowerShell 脚本组成，不新增 JavaScript/TypeScript 界面。插件采用 MIT 许可证；PhotoCraft 原始便携包的许可证和资源声明随运行时保留。项目不重新分发上游二进制或品牌资产。

[PhotoCraft](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

Two plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

| Plugin | Category | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-scholar](packages/dsh-scholar) | tools | Four model-facing tools for literature work — `paper_search`, `paper_get`, `paper_citations`, `book_search` — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall |
| [dsh-sidebar-tidy](packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy) | ui | Keeps the Web sidebar workspace and session list clickable when footer plugins grow tall, by capping and scrolling the plugin-action area |

Both are Cordis plugins that declare a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so they install with
`dsh plugin add`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-scholar
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy
```

Each package also works on its own — see its README for configuration and
limitations.

## Requirements

DSH 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer. `dsh-scholar` needs Node 20+; it imports
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` dynamically and degrades
gracefully when they are absent, which is why both are declared as *optional*
peers — installing these plugins never pulls official packages into your profile.

## Repository layout

```
packages/dsh-scholar/
  lib/sources.js      data layer — one pure function per source, no host dependency
  lib/index.js        host half — registers the four tools
  cordis.patch.yml    the bundle row
packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy/
  lib/client.js       browser half — the injected CSS
  lib/index.js        host half — an empty placeholder
  cordis.patch.yml    the bundle row
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-free-web-search **给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个不需要任何 API key 的 Web 搜索提供方**，附带代理支持与延迟测试。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)](#与已装插件共存以及为什么必须手动切换) [![Tests: 242 passing](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-242%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](#测试)
官方搜索走 DeepSeek 的 Anthropic 兼容接口，需要一个 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（或账号登录态）。这个插件换一条路：向 `ctx.web` 搜索缝隙注册一个 `free-web` 提供方，由**公开的免费后端**来回答搜索。 ``` free-web-search │ ├─ 0. bing bing.com/search（默认启用：无需配置、无需代理、实测稳定） │ │ 以下为可选后端，在设置页勾选后启用： ├─ 1. searxng 公开实例的 JSON API（元搜索，一次请求聚合多引擎） ├─ 2. google google.com/search（通用覆盖最好；通常需要代理） ├─ 3. baidu baidu.com/s（中文查询最强；实测可直连） ├─ 4. yandex yandex.com/search（俄语有用；常被验证码拦） ├─ 5. duckduckgo html / lite 结果页（无需配置，抓取型） └─ 6. wikipedia MediaWiki 官方 API（最稳，但只覆盖百科类） ``` **默认只启用 `bing`。** 它是唯一「不需要配置实例、不需要代理」且实测能稳定回答的后端，所以新装即可用，不会把延迟预算花在当前网络里根本答不了的后端上。其余后端都在设置页里，一个勾选框之遥；延迟测试会告诉你哪些在你这儿可达。 按顺序尝试，第一个给出可用结果的胜出。**可选项的顺序按可靠性而非结果质量排**：能稳定回答的普通引擎，胜过经常失败的高级引擎——因为失败要先用延迟买单才能轮到下一个。 ## 三个特性 ### 1. 多后端（含 Google / 百度 / Yandex） | 后端 | 类型 | 实测（本机，无代理） | | --- | --- | --- | | searxng | JSON API | ❌ 5 个公开实例全超时 | | **google** | 抓取 | ⚠️ 见下（**JavaScript 壳页**） | | **bing** | 抓取 | ✅ 10 条 / 546ms | | **baidu** | 抓取 | ✅ 5 条 / 1077ms（中文结果正确） | | **yandex** | 抓取 | ⚠️ HTTP 200 但是验证码页 | | duckduckgo | 抓取 | ❌ 两端点全超时 | | wikipedia | JSON API | ❌ 超时 | **Baidu 的解析基于实测而非猜测。** 抓下真实结果页（1.2MB）后发现：结果容器带 `mu="真实URL"` 属性，所以**不需要跟随跳转**就能拿到目标地址。这很关键——另一种做法（逐个解析 `baidu.com/link?url=` 跳转）会把请求数乘以结果条数。 同时实测到 `c-container` 这个类名在页面里出现 **105 次**，大部分在嵌入的 CSS 和一个反馈表单里，所以解析器**要求容器必须带 `mu=` 属性**，而不是只匹配类名。 **Yandex 的结果解析器未经验证**（抓取时只拿到验证码页，没有结果标记可对照）。这一点在 `src/backends/yandex.js` 里明确写了。已验证的是**验证码路径**——这反而更重要，因为它让"被拦"被如实报告，而不是误报成"页面改版"。 ### Google 的实测结论（重要） 配上可用代理后重测（代理 CONNECT 6ms 成功），Google **仍然拿不到结果**，但原因不是网络也不是解析器： ``` status: 200 最终 URL 正确 93,468 字节
